Starting as governor of a newly formed province in the Roman Empire your goal is simple: advance up the empire's political ladder to become the next Caesar.
죽음의 장애물 코스에서 자전거를 타는 아버지와 아들 그리고 재미있는 기타 가족 경험에 관한 게임.

The disappearance of an ambitious engineer and his high-society wife provokes a hunt for a precious artefact. The trail leads you to the attic of their home, and the discovery of an old, peculiar dollhouse. What secrets lie within these walls?

FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD brings an immersive world, memorable characters and the production value known of the series, together with high quality gameplay and storytelling truly worthy of the FINAL FANTASY name.
Hylics is a recreational program with light JRPG elements.
Like a bastard child of Quake 3 and Super Meat Boy, SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is truly hardcore and focuses on speed and fast reaction.

Play and study foreign words! Try dodge from blocks. When you loss, showing words in a foreign language. To complete each level hold 100 seconds. First two levels are quite simple, but starting from the third, it will be hard.
캡처와 사용자 맞춤 설정, 그리고 진화! 렌과 란 남매와 함께 광대한 그리모어를 탐험하며 그들의 과거를 밝히고 미래를 구하세요.
낡은 기차로 오픈월드 섬을 이동하고, 점차 업그레이드를 진행하고, Charles라고 불리는 사악한 거미 기차와 싸우세요.

Impossible Creatures is a 3D RTS game that pits the player against an evil villain. Using Earth’s most formidable animals as building blocks, the player must create an army of genetically-altered mutant monsters in a titanic struggle to protect an unsuspecting world.
조그만 사원들을 프로그래밍해서 퍼즐을 풀게 하세요. 쓸모 있는 직원이 되세요! 기계들이 당신의 직장을... 노리고 있으니까요. 이 게임은 월드 오브 구의 디자이너와 리틀 인페르노 팀이 협력하여 만들었습니다. 열일하세요! 관리 부서에서 지켜보고 있습니다.
Grow your farm, meet the villagers, and join your friends online in building your world.

Battle Chef Brigade pairs combo-based hunting and puzzle-based cooking in a hand drawn, fantasy adventure. Cook your way into the Brigade while subduing Victusia’s destructive monsters. Follow Mina and Thrash in the single-player campaign or challenge your friends in Local Multiplayer and Daily Cook-Offs.

We're obsessed with creating the most realistic VR table tennis simulator the world has ever seen. After 5 years and countless hours of hard work, we believe that we have accomplished that goal.: : : [Play over Oculus Link/AirLink/Virtual Desktop Not Recommended: the tracking will be much worse]

Guns, Gore & Cannoli 2 revives the good, old, action platform run & gun genre, but this time with a bunch of humor and buckets of blown off body parts. In this sequel to Guns, Gore & Cannoli, Vinnie Cannoli’s story continues and this time it’s personal.
COP BASTARD는 1990년대 초 일본을 배경으로 한 클래식 FPS입니다. 거침없는 형사가 되어 좁은 복도에서 몰려드는 야쿠자와 싸우세요. 퍼즐도, 특전도, 업그레이드도 없습니다. 오직 복도와 적, 그리고 적의 얼굴에 침을 뱉을 기회만 있습니다.

en: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002 UNLIMITED MATCH
ko: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002 UNLIMITED MATCH
desc: KOF 2002 UM is the 2nd title in the UM Series and a fully upgraded ver. of KOF 2002, a masterpiece of the KOF Series deserving its place of honor alongside KOF ’98. Based on THE NESTS CHRONICLES, 2002 UM includes the most characters of any title in the KOF Series, and fighting game history!
이 게임은 그의 생애를 통해 계속 달리던 사람에 관한 것입니다, 그는 과거를 돌아보지 않았습니다. 여행 중에 한번, 그는 문제에 휘말립니다. 지금 그는 차가운 땅에 누워 있으며, 자전거 아래에 묻혀 있습니다. 다양한 순간들의 슬라이드가 그의 머리를 지나가다.
Firefighting Simulator는 미국 대도시의 소방대원으로서 화재를 근거리에서 직접 진압하는 일을 경험해볼 수 있는 게임입니다. 협력 멀티플레이어를 통해 최대 3명의 친구와 함께하거나, 싱글플레이어 모드로도 즐길 수 있습니다.
A new six-degree-of-freedom shooter with intuitive controls, amazing lighting and graphics. From the creators of Descent, Overload is the best zero-gravity robot-blasting combat ever.
Evade the guards and the defences to escape the evil facility on this click and play stealth game, there will be difficult on your path, young padawan!
METAL GEAR SURVIVE builds upon MGSV’s stealth action gameplay with elements of exploration and survival creating a bold new experience. *An internet connection is required to play the game.
좋은 게임을 하고 싶으셨겠지만. 이제 당신은 그림판과 메모장 같은 윈도우 프로그램들을 이용해 퍼즐을 풀고, 당신의 컴퓨터에서 놓은 적 없는 파일들을 찾는 자기 자신을 발견할 것입니다... 그녀는 누굴까요? 왜 여러분의 컴퓨터에 나타난 걸까요? 기억 속으로 파고 들어가 찾아봅시다.

Dragon Saga is a f2p arcade style side scrolling 3D Fantasy MMORPG set in a world of Dragons and magic. Choose one of four classes (Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Archer) and explore a rich world filled with unique monsters. Power up to unlock devastating abilities, hidden combos and hilarious effects.
Our hero decided to escape from the hustle and bustle of the city and get out into nature to relax in a cabin that was in the mountains.

Just when you thought it was safe to eat chicken again, the chickens have returned with an organized invasion to take over the entire solar system! Journey to each planet and fight your way through to save the world (again)!

The hit crossover 2D fighter finally makes its way to PC, updated to the latest arcade version for character balancing, added background animations and additional winning poses. It also includes all DLC from the console release, such as additional fighters Homura and Heart, in a single value package.
The Fairytale Curse was only the beginning...

ko: 山河旅探 - Murders on the Yangtze River
desc: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.
A spaceship building and universe-exploration game. Collect resources, expand and grow your fleet, and conquer your personal galaxy. Stellar ambience by Peaks.

Grab your trench coat, tune your sixth sense and join the Darkside Division as they investigate the outright bizarre, the downright dangerous and the confusing cases of Twin Lakes. Flesh-hungry tentacles, mafian zombies, and the occasional missing sock are no match for The Darkside Detective.
In the entertaining and educational game Zoombinis, players guide the little blue creatures through fun and increasingly challenging puzzles on their way to a new home.
마인드 게임 - 이제 마인드 운동하는 것은 재미 있습니다!

A quiet evening stroll takes a turn for the worse as a tragic accident befalls a little girl and her dog. When her sister goes missing later in the night, the little girl decides to venture out into the eerie darkness to search for her loved ones as evil spirits haunt the alleyways and streets of her once-peaceful town.
실험실에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 여기에서는 최신 무기 기술을 사용하여 내구성이 높은 복제 인간을 대상으로 테스트를 실시합니다. 당신의 목표는 이러한 테스트를 이끄는 것입니다.
Become a Timberman, chop wood and avoid the branches. Almost 30 million players could not be wrong - featured as one of the best casual games.
Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is 1 second per second of advanced funkstyle. Battle rival crews and dispatch militarized police to conquer the five boroughs of New Amsterdam. Become All City.
For 3-8 Players and an Audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The gut-busting, say-anything, no-rules party game!

You awake to discover yourself no longer in the company of good men or a fine seafaring vessel. Treasure... you remember something about treasure. Wayward is a challenging turn-based, top-down, wilderness survival roguelike. Explore, build, and most importantly survive in these unforgiving lands.
AGEod goes back to the Napoleonic era and delivers the most detailed and comprehensive strategy game ever created about a time of struggle and conquest that forged modern Europe.

Two kingdoms in battle against each other, the king Bennevert called for the legendary mighty mercenaries to defend strategic posts in dangerous lands in the battlefield. Are you prepared to be a mercenary?
The classic arcade is back in a new style! It's time to prove that you are one of the best!
넓은 도시 지역에서 자유롭게 운전하는 버스 운전사의 삶을 경험하세요. Mercedes-Benz, Setra, MAN, IVECO BUS 브랜드의 공식 허가를 받은 도시 버스를 운전해 보세요. 싱글 플레이어 모드 또는 멀티플레이어 모드에서 탑승객들을 목적지까지 제시간에 안전히 데려다주세요.
Scam Line은 4~8명이 함께 즐기는 소셜 디셉션 게임으로, 당신의 파티는 다양한 도전에 맞서게 됩니다. 거짓말쟁이, 조종자, 사기꾼이 되거나, 자신만의 방식으로 승리를 쟁취하세요
Explore a vast and detailed world and build a Transportation Empire!
200개가 넘는 트랙에서 내 실력을 시험해보고 집에서 (오프라인 분할 화면) 또는 온라인을 통해 친구에게 도전하세요. 끝없는 경쟁: Trackbuilder에서는 나만의 트랙을 만들어 다른 플레이어와 공유할 수 있습니다!
데포니아의 운명을 바꿀 수 있나요? 실수로 행성 전체를 파괴하지 않고 루푸스의 과거, 현재 그리고 미래를 바꿀 수 있나요? 액션이 가득하고, 신나고, 미친 듯이 재미있는 이야기 속에서 시간과 싸우세요.
본 일인칭 슈퍼히로 게임에서 여러 차원을 넘나드는 불멸의 초능력자가 되어 외계인들의 침략에서 지구를 구하세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 당신의 힘이 너무가 강하기 때문에 다른 차원에 속한 표적이 빗나갈 경우에는 (본의 아니게) 초고층 건물들을 모두 파괴할 수도 있을 테니까...

Praey for the Gods is a boss climbing open world adventure game where you play a lone hero sent to the edge of a dying frozen land to explore and solve the secrets of a never ending winter. Grapple, glide and grab hold of massive beasts as you fight to survive and return the world to proper order.

en: Hello Charlotte EP2: Requiem Aeternam Deo
ko: Hello Charlotte EP2: Requiem Aeternam Deo
desc: A eulogy for happiness, and a lament for connection that never was.

EverQuest® II is a deep fantasy MMORPG with over two decades of content, a thriving world, and ongoing expansions that keep Norrath growing. Create your hero and adventure through a massively rich, ever-evolving universe.
기발한 임무와 미스테리한 신비한 음모가 가득한 Psychonauts 2는 영화같으면서 다양한 심령술이 조합가능한 플랫폼 기반 어드벤처 게임입니다.

en: LEGO Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game
ko: LEGO® Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game
desc: LEGO® Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game is an action adventure game that brings the Pirates of the Caribbean world and all its colorful characters to life in LEGO Brick form. Players experience all the memorable scenes from all four films in the humorous and quirky LEGO Video Games style.

en: ルナティックドーン 前途への道標
ko: ルナティックドーン 前途への道標
desc: Small tales add up to create a history that is all your own. Your mission is to seize the key of fate and build the history of this land.This game is only available in Japanese.
Battlefleet Gothic: Armada is the RTS videogame adaptation of Games Workshop’s classic tabletop game, pitting the Chaos, Imperium, Eldar, and Orks against each other in visceral space-battles.

Explore a breathtaking world floating above the clouds in this classic fantasy RPG. Battle an ancient vampire menace, forge powerful bonds with your companions, and experience the definitive Enhanced Edition packed with new content and improvements.
풍부한 판타지 세계를 탐험, 강력한 무기에 대한 탐구에 가서, 마법사 왕에서 새로운 문명을 위조 : 라이벌. 당신은 사악한 마법사 왕을 무너뜨리고 스스로 신이 될 문명을 구축 할 수 있습니까?
Prepare to accept history's greatest challenge: build the world's most powerful empire over a span of 6,300 years.
Contrast를 만든 독립 스튜디오에서 제작한 We Happy Few는 1960년대 대안 버전 영국의 한 마약 의존적인 복고풍 미래주의 도시를 배경으로 하는 액션/어드벤처 게임입니다. 이 조이에 미쳐 망상에 사로잡힌 세계에서 숨고, 싸우고, 순응하면서 탈출을 도모해 보세요.
Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

Get ready for an exciting real-time strategy game experience like no other with Seven Kingdoms 2! Say goodbye to the monotony of resource gathering and army building, its unique gameplay offers a thrilling blend of city management, trade, industry, espionage, diplomacy, and conquest!

en: Gary Grigsby's War in the East
ko: Gary Grigsby's War in the East
desc: War on an Epic scale from Moscow to Berlin – this is War in the East!
First released in arcades in 1980, the masterpiece PAC-MAN comes to Steam! Move PAC-MAN up, down, left, and right to avoid the ghosts and gobble up all the Pac-Dots!
번영하는 도시를 건설하세요. 다른 라이벌 기업과 타이탄에서 자원, 영토, 권력을 놓고 다투세요. 기술과 영향력, 전쟁, 시민들로부터 짜낸 부로 승리를 쟁취하세요. 창의적인 시뮬레이션/전략 게임 Industries of Titan에서 자신의 자리를 찾아보세요!
에니그메티스 3: 카할라의 그림자는 모험과 퍼즐, 고대 신화가 어우러진 멋진 퍼즐 어드벤처 블록버스터 3부작의 마지막 장입니다. 악마를 숭배하는 '전도사'의 뒤를 쫓으며 카할라 봉우리에 얽힌 비밀을 파헤치십시오!

Action roguelike for 1-4 players with cute graphics and deep game mechanics. Combine dozens of different weapons, magic items, potions and spells with unique effects to beat 8 enemy factions and 28 bosses. Can you find the ancient goblin artifact at the end of the dungeon?
"파이널 판타지 IV" -- 드디어 Steam에 등장!

rFactor is a realistic easily extendable racing simulation from Image Space Incorporated. It offers the latest in vehicle and race customization, great graphics, outstanding multiplayer, and the height of racing realism.
1~8명의 친구와 함께하는 아늑한 온라인 협동 땅파기 게임. 햇살 가득한 뒷마당에 구덩이를 파고, 광석과 잃어버린 설계도를 찾고, 작업장에서 멋진 물건을 만들어 전 세계 손님에게 보내 보세요. 손님들은 편지와 사진으로 답장해 줍니다. 제한 시간은 없어요. 그냥 파세요.
An independent story-based cinematic FPS game describing the drama of a student 's. Story is based on experienced emotions.
올스타급 캐스팅의 영웅들이 이 귀여우면서도 혼돈적인 새로운 컬러 매칭 온라인 대전게임에 그들의 배짱을 시험하기 위해 모였습니다. 크리스탈 크라이시스는 대전 격투게임처럼 보여지지만, 플레이어들은 낙하하는 크리스탈들을 정렬하고 화면상에서 없애버리는 방식으로 상대방을 공격하게 됩니다. 이제 궁극의 온라인 퍼즐 대전을 즐겨보십시오!

Slay enemies with speed and precision in an over-the-top show of blood and explosions. Play solo or with others, make split-second decisions, dodge bullets, and use weapons and abilities to inflict violence in the most graphic way possible.

Following the loss of a baby, a breakup, and a surprise heritage, Daphné decides to leave everything behind to start a new life in the French countryside. There, she discovers she's the last descendant of a line of witches. Will she embrace the family tradition?

en: peakvox Mew Mew Chamber for Steam
ko: peakvox Mew Mew Chamber for Steam
desc: Let's slide lovely cats in the crowd! They disappear when line up 3-same kinds of cats and the others get the crowded out of the field! It's the deceptive simplicity and how KAWAII (very sweet) new challenging puzzle! This game is compatible with the network ranking. Let's try to compete with the world users!

Terminator: Resistance, is a first-person shooter set during the 'Future War' scenario that was only glimpsed at in the iconic films, 'THE TERMINATOR' and 'T2: JUDGMENT DAY'. The machines are destined to lose, but at what cost?

Game and software creation has never been easier or quicker than with Clickteam Fusion 2.5! Discover the tool used by so many multimedia professionals, game creators, and creative people from all walks of life.

In Tokyo’s popular ”Electric Town” district, Akihabara, vampires called “Synthisters” walk among us. You must identify and dispose of them the only way you know how – by engaging them in hand-to-hand combat in order to strip them of their clothes so their bodies melt away in the sunlight.
Race Track Builder is a software design tool that has a simple, easy to use interface that allows you to build fantasy race tracks or use Google Maps data to create real-life terrain and roads.
아일렛 온라인은 샌드박스 스타일의 MMORPG입니다. 블럭을 캐서, 자신만의 마을을 건설해 보세요. 다양한 자원으로 유용한 아이템을 만들 수도 있습니다. 귀여운 동물을 키우고, 낚시를 하며, 힐링을 해보세요.!
Control Craft 3은 빠르게 진행되는 RTS로, 행성을 정복하는 행동에 대한 빠른 사고와 영리한 전술을 제공합니다!

It’s Christmas 1998. The world’s most annoying toy just came out, and yours won’t stay in his box. Can you stop Tattletail from getting you in trouble before the bloodthirsty Mama Tattletail hunts you down? Story-driven first person horror. New DLC Included!
Tails of Iron은 잔혹한 전쟁이 펼쳐지는 에픽 RPG 어드벤처입니다. 왕위 계승자 레지가 되어, 왕국을 되찾기 위해 아주 위험한 퀘스트를 시작하세요. 믿을 수 없을 정도로 매력적인 세계로의 탐험을 시작하세요. 용감한 동료들을 모으고 무자비한 개구리 부족을 단 번에 몰아내세요!

en: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut
ko: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut
desc: Embark on an adventure in a gothic-noir world, where mad science threatens the peace between monsters and mortals. The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut is definitive edition of the trilogy with six playable classes and a new endgame mode with a huge variety of open missions!

Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, Billiards, Pub Pool, 27 games total!“So realistic it will make your real life pool game better!”Compete in tournaments or play with friends. Player profile, statistics, calendar, shot upload, tournaments, lobby with chat. Grab a cue and play now!

In Power & Revolution, become a Head of State of one or several countries of your choice and extend your influence on the world, or play as a legal or illegal opposition leader and get ready for the conquest to power!
BUILD CIRCUITS. WRITE CODE. RTFM.
This Betrayal pack includes two games: Betrayal at Krondor and Betrayal in Antara.
이상하면서도 뒤틀린 저택을 조사하여 긴장감 넘치는 미스터리를 풀어가며 호기심이 생기는 단서를 찾고, 특이한 용의자를 심문하고, 특별한 퍼즐을 푸세요. Tangle Tower의 비밀을 밝힐 수 있을까요?
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of ruthless and mysterious world of Ridge, in order to all the secrets have finally been revealed. Not everyone dares to wade through.

en: RESONANCE OF FATE/END OF ETERNITY 4K/HD EDITION
ko: RESONANCE OF FATE™/END OF ETERNITY™ 4K/HD EDITION
desc: This symphonic gunplay RPG, where you can change the fate of the world, has been remastered in a 4K/HD EDITION. Fly through the air and enjoy the blazing gun battles in this fateful tale set on a ruined planet.
Cyber Manhunt is a story-oriented puzzle game focusing on big data, hacking, citizen privacy, and social workers. It focuses on social issues such as cyber violence and privacy breaches.
Tales of Maj’Eyal은 전략적 턴 기반 전투와 뛰어난 캐릭터 빌딩이 특징인 로그라이크 RPG입니다. 다양하고 독특한 종족/직업들 중 하나를 골라 수많은 이야기로 가득 찬 에이알의 세계에서 변화무쌍한 던전을 탐험하고 강적에 맞서 싸우며, 갖가지 능력들을 마음대로 조합하여 자신만의 방법으로 캐릭터를 성장시켜 나가세요.
바이킹이 돌아온다!

Ghost of a Tale is an action-RPG game in which you play as Tilo, a mouse and minstrel thrown into a perilous adventure. Through stealth and cunning you’ll be able to explore the secrets of Dwindling Heights Keep and navigate its dangers.

Firefight is a World War II real-time simulation game similar in style to the old Close Combat series but brought up to date with better AI, individual soldier modelling, a faster frame rate to give more intense and realistic combat and an easy to use command interface.

Warhammer 40,000: Sanctus Reach is a 3D turn-based strategy game like you’ve never seen before: fast, immediate, deep, impressive to look at and incredibly fun! Fight through a dark era of carnage and endless war and lead the Space Wolves in a struggle to defend the last bastion of mankind.
Miscreated is a multiplayer online hardcore survival game set in a post-apocalyptic future. You will need to survive against mutants, players, and even mother nature herself.
A world where time has no meaning - and evil knows no bounds. Torn from a world long gone, the time traveling warrior Turok has found himself thrust into a savage land torn by conflict.

Machine Made: Rebirth is a classic fantasy/sci-fi RPG, you will play as Tibby, an angelic girl lost in a world of advanced technology, magic and corruption. Having lost her memories, Tibby must find a way to rediscover her history and her true self to overthrow the evil Machine God that threatens the world.
뇌와 기술이 발달한 세계를 무대로 자신의 '염력'과 동료들이 가진 다양한 힘을 구사하여 싸우는 초뇌능력 액션, 그리고 2명의 주인공 시점에서 그려지는 중후한 이야기를 체험할 수 있는 '브레인 펑크 액션 RPG' 게임
FINAL FANTASY XIII-2는 FINAL FANTASY XIII의 정통 속편입니다. 탐색 요소를 강화한 필드, 몬스터를 동료로 삼아 전략성을 높인 배틀, 시간여행을 테마로 펼치는 스토리 등 다양한 진화를 이루었습니다.

Strategy from the front lines! Starpoint Gemini Warlords combines 3rd person capital spaceship combat with 4X strategy and RPG gameplay elements. Build mighty war fleets and send them into battle or lead them into combat yourself. Become the Warlord and conquer the Gemini system!
Mahjong Deluxe 3는 다양한 수상 경력에 빛나는 EnsenaSoft가 제작한 인기 절정의 캐주얼 마작 게임 시리즈 중 최신작입니다. 여러 버전을 통틀어 천5백만 다운로드를 기록한 Mahjong Deluxe 블록버스터 시리즈는 쉬운 사용, 직관적인 조작법, 가족 친화적인 기능 및 콘텐츠로 계속해서 플레이어들을 사로잡고 있습니다.
Book of Demons는 당신이 퀘스트의 길이를 결정하는 핵 & 슬래쉬 덱 빌딩의 복합적인 게임입니다. 오래된 성당 아래 지하 감옥에서 무기 대신 마법 카드를 이용해서 어둠의 군대를 무찌르세요. 아크 데몬의 손아귀에서 공포에 빠진 종이 세계를 구해주세요!

Ben and Ed is a 3D platformer, in which the player controls Ed the Zombie, who is forced to participate in a grotesque game show called "Rundead". Will he beat all obstacles Hans Showmaster confronts him with, to save his best friend Ben?
어떡하죠?! 타누키 대축제가 한 달밖에 안 남았는데, 신사가 엉망진창이에요. 살짝 게으른 타누키 '폰'을 도와 여름이 끝나기 전에 신사를 원상태로 돌려줄래요? 우체국에서 파트타임 집배원으로 일하는 폰과 함께 우편물을 전달하고, 친구를 사귀고, 신사를 복구하여 성대한 축제를 맞이하세요!
"My Butler" is a game where you can enjoy falling in love with your personal butler. Each butler is a celebrity; sometimes they'll approach you softly...and sometimes forcefully.
The world of Gloriana, with all its wonderful diversity, awaits you.
From the award-winning developers at Arkane® Studios comes Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider, the next standalone adventure in the critically-acclaimed Dishonored® series.
GRIP은 격렬한 속도와 중무기로 완전 무장한 하이옥탄 하드코어 전투 레이스입니다.

A mysterious force targets Sidni, and she must flee to keep her home and friends safe! Sidni finds herself in a strange land that holds the keys to her past. On her adventure, she meets new friends and discovers a bizarre army, which is amassing to sweep the world, with herself as its primary target!
Nekojishi is a visual novel about feline beast-men, Taiwanese folklore, and the pressures and consequences that come with navigating the world of gods and spirits.
살아남으려면 광대하게 펼쳐친 황량한 제리코 시티를 탐험하세요. 무자비하고 가차없는 전투 속에서 휘몰아치는 맹렬한 공격에 맞서 싸우며 상대의 사지를 찢어발긴 뒤 장비를 탈취하세요.

Struggle to survive in a harsh medieval world. Hunt wildlife, mine resources, build structures, and craft weapons and armor in order to protect yourself. You may form a guild, bring war to all opposition, and try to seize the throne and become king!
바닥이 용암이에요! 뜨거운 녹은 용암이 넘치고 향수가 가득한 환경에서 달리고, 점프하고, 등반하고, 서핑하세요. 혼자 탐험하거나 친구와 함께하세요. 바닥에 대지 마세요!

Fight alongside your troops in the sweltering desert heat of the Sahara or in the blustery heights of the Italian Alps. Wield your strategic prowess to gain the upper hand by the light of day and exploit the dark shroud of night to launch surprise attacks. Tanks, planes, troops, weapons - the resources are at your command.

Rotary-wing aviation and helicopter combat with a dynamic battlefield and the support of ground forces. Appreciated for MMO elements and an addictive gameplay loop. Use tactics and make strategic decisions or fly around and shoot in historically accurate maps.
Stories Untold is a compilation tape of four experimental adventures, including a remaster of the original hit episode “The House Abandon”.

는Unreal Engine 4로제작된샌드박스형 RPG로서환상적이고방대한오픈월드를구현하고있다. 현실감넘치는기후시스템, 광활한오픈월드, 다양한생명체및스릴넘치는서바이벌콘텐츠가있을뿐만아니라높은자유도를제공하는건축시스템, 독자적인스킬시스템, 펫시스템, 채집제작등멀티형경영시스템도체험할수있다.또한대규모진영대전과자유로운마법전장은 PK의모든것을담아냈다. 생존,탐험,협력,정복..!새로운세계의개척자가될것인지아니면이땅의수호자될것인지..!세계의어둠(Dark)과빛(Light)의운명을스스로결정해보자!
지금 힘든 시기입니다 폐하. 사람들이 가지고 있는 문제는 우리의 해결능력을 넘어서고 있고 전쟁이 일어날 수도 있습니다. 신중한 결정이 필요합니다.

Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation is an exciting, fully detailed simulation of the eventful life of a big city fire department. It was developed in cooperation with and modelled on the fire brigade of Mülheim, Germany. Mülheim has one of the largest and most modern fire stations in Europe.
"Warstone은 RPG, 전략, 그리고 도시 건설의 요소가 어우러진 타워 디펜스 게임입니다. 고화질의 그래픽, 아름다운 일러스트와 심도 있는 스토리가 어우러져, 당신을 Warstone의 세계로 안내합니다."
염력, 고문 기구의 특이한 사용, 재빠른 재주와 그림자 여우의 도움으로 깊고 깊은 던전으로 향하는 글라스 마운틴의 정상에서 자신만의 방법을 개척합니다.
그 전설은 오랫동안 잊혀진 예언... 눈부신 영웅과 아주 위험한 모험... 사악한 힘, 낯선 세상 그리고 요정 떼를 전하지만... 큰 검 대신 큰 마음을 지닌 소녀에 대한 문구는 없습니다!
DARQ는 Lloyd라는 소년이 자신이 꿈을 꾸고 있다는 사실을 깨닫게 되는 이야기입니다.

The classic card game is back in a digital version that everyone can play! Enjoy a quick game or chase after points to climb up the world rankings. 4 different settings and 3 popular game modes. Quite simply, Solitaire.

Capturing the hearts of countless fans since 2007, Little Busters! is an emotional visual novel from Key, the minds behind Angel Beats! and CLANNAD. This special English release supports touch controls and dynamic switching between English and Japanese text, and is in HD for the first time on PC.
Take revenge on your father’s killer!
Ape Out은 원시적인 탈출과 리듬적인 폭력, 열광적인 재즈를 담고 있는 강렬하면서도 다채로운 스타일리시 파괴 액션 게임입니다.
Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

The Sexy Brutale — a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult! Relive the same mysterious day where the guests at the casino mansion are being murdered by the staff over and over again...
삽질 기사: 매장된 보물은 삽질 기사의 웅대한 이야기를 담은 총 5편의 게임을 하나로 묶은 완전판입니다! 고전 도트 그래픽 게임에서 영감을 얻어 창조된 환상적인 세계! 인상적인 캐릭터들이 등장하는 월드클래스 급 액션 어드벤처 속에서 파내고 파괴하고 베고 강타하며 앞으로 나아가세요!

Vagante is an action-packed platformer that features permanent death and procedurally generated levels. Play cooperatively with friends both locally and online, or adventure solo in this challenging roguelike-inspired game.
Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.

Northern Canada, 1970. A strange blizzard ravages Atamipek Lake. Step into the shoes of a detective to explore the eerie village, investigate surreal events, and battle the elements to survive. Kona is a chilly interactive tale you won't soon forget.

Tabletopia is a sandbox virtual table with high-quality board games and ready setups. Already 2,400+ games and counting! Play how you want with whom you want: guests don’t need accounts to play. Or make your own games, no programming skills required.

en: Space Pilgrim Episode III: Delta Pavonis
ko: Space Pilgrim Episode III: Delta Pavonis
desc: Still reeling from the life-changing events of the previous episode, Gail seeks out a safe haven with her father in the Delta Pavonis system. However, she soon learns that the politics of Planet Leto can be as treacherous and unpredictable as the local weather.
Rick and Morty: Virtual Rick-ality smashes together the absolute VR chaos of the award-winning Job Simulator with the ridiculous, all-out, take-no-prisoners comedy of Rick and Morty.

Welcome in Bad Dream: Coma. A point & click game where unique minimalistic art style creates an unforgettable and atmospheric experience. Travel through the surreal and disturbing dreamland where everything depends on your actions. You can't die but you can suffer greatly...
신규 업데이트! AI 공격대와 함께하는 솔로 플레이나 온라인 협동 플레이를 즐겨보세요. 식스 데이즈 인 팔루자는 긴장감 넘치고 사실적인 1인칭 전술 슈팅 게임으로, 금세기 가장 치열했던 시가전에서의 실화를 바탕으로 합니다.
"GRANDIA II"가 더욱 개선된 모습으로 부활합니다! 고전 일본 RPG 명작이 향상된 그래픽, 새로 추가된 난이도, 키보드 및 게임 패드 지원과 함께 돌아왔습니다!

From commanding the battle standing on the bridge of your flagship all the way down to tactical infantry firefights - AFF brings together all the combat you ever loved in a rich science fiction setting. Boarding, pilotable capital ships, deep weapon customization and full Bot support included!

The sequel to the party game phenomenon The Jackbox Party Pack, featuring FIVE fresh, rib-tickling party games! Your phones or tablets are your controllers – no big mess of controllers needed. For up to 8 players plus an Audience of up to 10,000! It’s a game-night riot in a box… without the box!

en: Serious Sam VR: The Last Hope
ko: Serious Sam VR: The Last Hope
desc: 시리어스 샘이 돌아옵니다! 그리고 이번엔 '진짜'에요!

Therian Saga is a MMORPG that tries to stand out of the crowd by offering a compelling storytelling surrounded by a massive mathematical set of rules that define the world your hero will evolve in. It could be said that it borrows elements from old-time MUD games, strategy games and even tabletops RPG.
지금까지 가장 큰 우주 기반 전략 게임에서 시간의 시험을 서 있을 문명을 구축! 수십 개의 독특한 종족 중에서 선택하고 외교, 간첩, 기술 발전 등을 통해 은하계를 가로 질러 자신의 이름을 지정하십시오.

Find all the cars, all the drivers and all the official rallies of the 2015 FIA World Rally Championship in THE racing simulation standard. Realistic driving on different road surfaces, dynamic damage, day/night system, weather… Experience all the sensations of rally racing in WRC 5!

1872, with a steampunk twist. Phileas Fogg has wagered he can circumnavigate the world in just 80 days. Travel by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more. Race other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's Game of 2014.

You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

Leaping from mind-boggling heights, bouncing off Champolines, soaring inches from floating islands, BUD can do it all - that look of mild terror, that’s his daredevil face. Help the adorable little robot collect MOM’s scattered ship parts and return them to the moon.
KARAKARA. It is the sound of aridity. It is the sound of dry asphalt and sandy winds. It is the sound of relentless sunshine, as well as the sound of a withering race.
전략 로그라이트 오토배틀러에서 무적의 군대를 만들어 보세요. 배너링을 융합하고 강력한 엠블럼 시너지를 만들어 예측할 수 없는 전투를 헤쳐 나가 최종 보스에 도전하세요.
Inhabiting the World of Darkness, you must face a series of brutal confrontations with your nemesis Vukodlak, a powerful vampire lord.
얼어붙은 땅을 탐험하는 중에 다시 한 번 불운이 찾아왔습니다. 맹렬한 눈보라를 뚫고 비상용 신호탄이 하늘을 밝힌 뒤 무전을 통해 도움을 구하는 울부짖는 소리가 들립니다. 무전이 끊깁니다... 누구도 그들을 구하러 갈 수 없습니다. 하지만 함께라면 할 수 있지 않을까요?
밤낮으로 달리고, 로드 바론을 위해 위험한 일을 맡고, 끝없이 위험한 도로에서 교통 체증과 다른 바이커를 피하고, 이 모든 것을 하면서 오리지널 펑크 록 음악을 틀어보세요!

Battle huge "Koju" bugs in CAVE's beautiful fantasy shooter, Mushihimesama. Experience the thrill of bullet hell from the masters of the genre as you evade visually stunning shot patterns with thousands of bullets.
Hob의 세계를 변화시키세요! Torchlight I 및 Torchlight II를 개발한 스튜디오로 수상 경력에 빛나는 Runic Games의 새로운 액션 어드벤처 게임. 기회를 놓치지 말고 평화로운 안식처를 넓히세요.
‘젤다의 전설’과 ‘사일런트 힐’에 영감을 받아 만들어진 픽셀 어드벤처 게임입니다.
I can see the signs in my sleep now, always guiding me closer. Will this really work? Have we almost achieved the impossible?
그것은 새총을 가진 사람들을 촬영하지만, 조심하는 재미, 그들은 무장하고 위험하다!

en: Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk
ko: Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk
desc: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk의 차기작. 절망적이고 혼란스러운 세계로 뛰어들어 소녀가 조금 더 행복해질 수 있도록 도와주세요.

KeeperRL is a retro dungeon simulator with roguelike and RPG elements. Take the role of an evil keeper and build a formidable dungeon. Recruit sinister minions, equip and train them to explore the world and fight the forces of good.

Sphere 3 is an MMORPG featuring large-scale castle sieges with siege engines, epic battles with ancient monsters, a flexible progression system, and a non-target combat system. Join Sphere 3, become a legend!
"I need a Heart in order to open it"
LUNA The Shadow Dust는 100% 손으로 그린 그래픽 기반의 포인트 앤 클릭 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임으로, 언어가 없는 스토리텔링과 아름다운 동영상 및 고이장한 오리지널 사운드트랙을 통해 활기를 띠게 해 줍니다.

In a creaky old tavern, in a forgotten corner of the video-game universe, a storm is raging. An anonymous caller suggests that there is a murder plot. Six video game protagonists are the only plausible suspects...

In Thimbleweed Park, a dead body is the least of your problems. Switch between five playable characters to uncover the surreal secrets of this strange town in a modern mystery adventure game from the creators of Monkey Island and Maniac Mansion. The deeper you go, the weirder it gets.

en: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart
ko: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart
desc: Space adventure, open world RPG, strategy, arcade, quest and more!
Shape your citizen, forge your destiny and sculpt your world in this epic voxel sandbox MMO built on endless possibility.
Marble Age is a turn-based historical strategy where your task is to turn a small Ancient Greek village into a flourishing Polis, powerful enough to conquer the known world!
모든 원피스 팬이 기다려온 바로 그 게임. One Piece Burning Blood는 세계에서 가장 유명한 해적인 몽키 D. 루피가 등장하는 다이나믹하고 화려한 격투 게임입니다.

The epic based classic online game Khan takes on where Genghis Khan reached the end of his expedition. The game takes place at small kingdom of Eurasia where Genghis Khan's brutal force was never able to conquer. You will re-visit the history and prepare the battles against the greatest conquer of history.

Turbo Pug is back! and this time, he's airborne! Fly through deserts, green fields and more stunning environments. Dodge an onslaught of enemies and go head to head with giant bosses! Unlock new costumes for Turbo Pug and new creatures to play as. Please try not to squish your pug!
일본에서 영감을 받은 영혼 시장을 건설하고 운영하세요. 떠도는 영혼들을 맞이하고 자원을 생산·판매하며, 추억과 아늑한 분위기 속에서 공간을 성장시키세요.

Lara Croft GO is a turn based puzzle-adventure set in a long-forgotten world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilization, discover well-kept secrets and face deadly challenges as you uncover the myth of the Queen of Venom.

en: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie Video Game
ko: The LEGO® NINJAGO® Movie Video Game
desc: 좋아하는 닌자로 플레이하면서 사악한 로드 가르마돈으로부터 닌자고를 지켜내세요. 벽 달리기, 고공 점프 등의 닌자 기술을 익히고 적과의 전투를 통해 전투 실력을 업그레이드시키세요.
Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.
Bleeding Border is a first person 3d survival horror game in which the player must escape through the top of a monster infested building using his own blood as the only defense mechanism.
Play the strategy game of money, power and wealth.
Time in Time is a side scroller puzzle-platformer game where you control everything with timers..
Sundered는 섬뜩한 고대의 힘에 저항하거나 그 힘을 받아들여야 하는 혼란으로 가득한 손으로 그린 스타일의 메트로이드베니아 게임입니다. H.P.Lovecraft 작품의 영감을 받은 끊임없이 변화하는 세계 속에서 무시무시한 적 무리에 맞서 보세요.

Explore the strange unknown with Pathway, a strategy adventure set in the 1930s great wilderness. Unravel long-forgotten mysteries of the occult, raid ancient tombs and outwit your foes in turn-based squad combat!

You have 3 weeks to get a date for Monster Prom! Go through absurd and funny situations, raise your stats and seduce one of your classmates. Beautiful art, bold, unapologetic dialogue and hard choices make up this Multiplayer (1-4 players) Dating Sim. Be your worst self.

MARS is a Free-To-Play Third Person Shooter set in an evolving sci-fi world. From the hilarious Headhunter mode, to Huge Mecha vs Mecha battles, to fully customizable loadouts; whether Co-op or PvP, M.A.R.S. has something for everyone. Kill, Die, Repeat.

en: Decisive Campaigns: The Blitzkrieg from Warsaw to Paris
ko: Decisive Campaigns: The Blitzkrieg from Warsaw to Paris
desc: Decisive Campaigns: The Blitzkrieg from Warsaw to Paris is the first in an innovative series of operational World War II wargames that also include a strategic element. The Blitzkrieg from Warsaw to Paris simulates Germany’s military successes in Poland and France in 1939 and 1940 .
혼자 또는 친구들과 서사시적 모험을 떠나세요! 던전을 탐험하고, 괴물을 포획하며, 마을을 건설하고 방어하세요. 무기를 만들고, 마법을 익혀 외계 행성을 새로운 문명의 요람으로 만드세요! 이 혁신적인 게임에서 세계의 운명을 좌우하세요!

Super Sonico is a cheerful, hardworking college student and amateur musician who's about to make her modeling debut. As her personal photographer, you will be responsible for Sonico's image, balancing the needs of your clients with your own vision for Sonico's future.
RTS와 대전략 장르가 결합된 피비린내 나는 공선전을 치르며 중세의 역사를 다시 써보세요. 중세 유럽의 하급 군주가 되어 도시를 통치하고, 건설하고, 왕을 섬기세요. 공성전은 물론, 필드 전투, 해상 전투를 치르며 지금까지 본 적 없는 잔혹함을 경험하세요. 로그라이크 방식의 진행, 대규모 마을 경영과 전투가 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다...

Thrust into a parallel dimension, our buxom shinobi prepare for a new kind of beach-side battle. Can the islands’ hosts be trusted? Will the other schools play fair? Will there be time to enjoy the beach before the fighting starts? Will anyone manage to keep their clothes intact?
몸은 작지만 개성은 넘치는 고양이인 당신은 호기심을 품은 채, 집으로 돌아가는 길을 찾아 모험을 떠납니다. 도시를 탐험하고, 떠돌이 동물들과 친구가 되고, 사랑스러운 모자를 쓰고, 가는 곳마다 말썽을 일으켜 보세요. 뭐니 뭐니 해도, 그런 건 고양이 전문 분야잖아요?

Return to the bloody battlefields of World War II in this epic sequel. Blitzkrieg 2 returns you to the gritty realism of WWII battles while pushing your focus into new, strategic opportunities during global war!

화려하게 구현된 식민지 시대의 인도에서 주인공 알바즈가 되어, 2.5D 잠입 플레이를 통해 복수의 퀘스트를 수행해 보십시오. • 19세기 인도를 누비며 전설적인 랜드마크들도 확인해 보십시오. . • 다중 살해나 차크람 같은 독특한 스킬과 무기를 활용하여 긴장감 넘치는 잠입 플레이를 즐겨 보십시오. • 속도감 넘치는 잠입 플레이로 새로운 공간에서 펼쳐지는 신규 모드 역시 즐겨 보십시오.

An online multiplayer game about shapeshifting deception and betrayal! As a hapless, brave spaceman employed by The Company you'll work diligently to defend and be rescued from failing outposts, but not everyone around you is who they claim to be...
As commander of a squadron of cavalry, what will you sacrifice to win the war of gunpowder and magic? Fight for power, riches, love, or glory!
Predators lurk, food is scarce, you must adapt - or go extinct. Evolve your species to survive and dominate as you explore the campaign or go head-to-head with the skill-based matchmaker.
와일드테라(Wild Terra) 는 MMO 장르로써 중세의 세계를 완벽하게 플레이어 주도 하에 생생하게 경험할 수 있습니다. 여기에서는 모두가 자신의 영혼이 갈망하는 직업을 발견 할 것입니다. 세계를 탐험하고, 사냥하고, 제작하고, 집을 꾸미고, 전투와 공성전등. 생존자로 시작하여 심지어 왕까지 될수 있습니다!
Force of Nature is a Sandbox game that combines Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Management genres
Griftlands는 협상하거나 싸우거나 훔치거나 설득하며 나아가는 덱 빌딩 로그라이트 게임입니다. 맡는 일, 사귀는 친구, 수집하는 카드 등 결정 하나하나가 중요합니다.

en: Making History: The Calm and the Storm Gold Edition
ko: Making History: The Calm and the Storm Gold Edition
desc: Making History Gold Edition is the expanded and updated version of the original WWII grand strategy game Making History: Calm & the Storm. Command your nation and change the course of history.

3030 Deathwar is a unique mix of Adventure and Space Sim. Explore star systems, mine and hunt pirates in top-down mode. Leave your ship and switch into classic Adventuring mode, where you explore derelicts, talk to shady characters or head over to the space bar for a drink.
「부탁이야. 제발, 나를 죽여줘」「여기서 나갈 수 있도록 도와줘. 그럼 너를, 죽여주지」 "살육의 천사"는 Episode 1부터 Episode 4까지 4부로 구성된 사이코 호러 어드벤쳐 게임입니다. 일부 과격한 표현이 포함되어 있습니다.
'Bacteria' - A relaxing puzzle game based on the rules of the cellular automaton ‘Life’ devised by John Horton Conway in 1970.

Behold an anime-themed land of wonders, friendship and skill, shrouded in the mysteries of an ancient world yours to explore. Forge relationships and find new friends, take up a job, or soar through the majestic skies as you rediscover a social MMORPG beloved by many around the world!

For the first time, RPG Maker 2000 is available in English! Since its debut 15 years ago, the beloved game-making engine has introduced untold amounts of users to the wonders of game design and continues to be a powerful, user-friendly tool.

The legendary bullet-hell shoot-’em-up series has come to Steam! DoDonPachi is ressurected after a Blissful Death with enough modes to satisfy the beginner and the expert player alike. Tonight we dine in bullet hell!
Boasting beautiful, hand-drawn animations and a re-orchestrated soundtrack, the cult classic returns with a unique blend of exploration, action, and adventure!

A family simulation set in China, 1500–1850, in the canal and rice country around Suzhou: land, exams, shops, courts, lineage feuds, combat. Your family may live through the late Ming, the Manchu conquest and the Opium War — or it may not. It does not have to be honest.
Gorogoa(고로고아)는 Jason Roberts가 디자인하고 일러스트레이션을 손으로 그린 아름다운 차세대 퍼즐 게임입니다.
There isn’t much better than a wide open game world in which you have essentially no limits and can alter the very landscape in which you play – that is, unless you add dragons, of course…
Play as Lightning McQueen, a rookie racecar looking to win fame and fortune at the Piston Cup Championship, in the video game adaptation of Disney•Pixar's Cars.

Make the Reds side triumph to save the Soviet Proletarian revolution, or, on the other side, lead the Whites side to victory in order to place the old regime back in power and protect the countries of Europe from the perils of the revolution. This is the biggest civil war game you will ever play!
DEADBOLT is an extremely challenging stealth-action hybrid that allows you to take control of the reaper to quell the recent undead uprising.

Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.
Democrats Vs Republicans! It's the political battle of the decade!
The critically acclaimed Valkyria Chronicles is now available on PC in 1080p True HD, including all previously released DLC!

역사상 가장 위대한 전투, 녹색군 대 황갈색군의 대결에 참여하세요. 온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 함께, 또 맞서 싸우세요. 빠른 템포의 목표 기반 게임플레이로 점프하고, 쏘고, 구르며 승리를 쟁취하세요. 때로는 가장 위대한 전투가 가장 작은 병사들에 의해 벌어집니다. The Mean Greens는 장난감 병정의 시점에서 플레이하는 온라인 멀티플레이 3인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
축구 선수의 삶을 온전히 경험하세요. 경기와 훈련 사이에는 자유롭게 운전하며 누빌 수 있는 도시가 기다립니다. 커리어를 쌓고, 번 돈을 쓰고, 명성이 가져오는 모든 일에 대처하세요.

Step into the wild world of Nightclub Simulator VR! Experience an exclusive party where you can dance, mingle, fight, or flirt your way through a chaotic nightclub scene. Interact with lifelike NPCs, build relationships, cause a little mayhem, or just enjoy the music. Your night, your rules..

Merchant blends traditional RPG systems and tycoon style mechanics. No gems, no consumables, all purchases are DLC! Great for second screen gaming! Merchant reimagines the classic RPG experience from the perspective of a Merchant. Hire Heroes and Crafters to do your bidding for you.

Embark on an epic sci-fi, free-to-play adventure. Spacelords is a brand-new take on the shooter genre. Through its 4 vs 1 campaign, you experience both sides of the story: Join the Raiders in their fight to free the legendary Broken Planet, or switch sides and fight as the Antagonist alongside the invading hordes!
Drift Horizon Online - immersive drifting simulator featuring smooth optimized visuals, realistic physics, and authentic car sounds including blow-off, exhaust, backfires and tire skids.
Get prepared for the FIRST EVER shooter game based on Rage Comics ! Rage Wars is a well-made action game with a variety of weapons, worlds and enemies to challenge with.
수많은 팬으로부터 사랑받은 명작 Worms™ Armageddon의 용감무쌍한 꿈틀이들이 칼을 갈고 돌아왔습니다. 적진을 돌파하고 전장을 쓸어버린 뒤, 마지막까지 살아남는 웜이 되어 웜즈의 옛 영광을 되찾으세요.
처음 보는 동물들과 퍼즐, 몬스터, 어지러운 정치 싸움으로 가득한 이상하면서도 매력적인 세계에서 새로운 집을 찾는 추방자 ‘움’이 되어 플레이합니다.

War of Omens is a CCG with a unique Deckbuilder combat system and deep strategy. Set in a masterfully crafted dark fantasy world, it features fast, strategic battles with 4 distinct factions and over 20 heroes. Challenge the online ladder, conquer the story mode, or compete in a cross faction draft!

Tap Tap Infinity is a fully 3D incremental RPG. Hire Heroes to fight for you, even with the game closed! Gain unimaginable DPS, mountains of gold, conquer thousands of levels and millions of monsters on your quest to defeat ‘The Master'.

It’s just a red tomato wearing a silly hat. He tries to look like a cool tomb raider, rolling and jumping across the maps. Help him find all the treasures in the mystic castle, or watch him meet a variety of painful ends.
Warfare Studios (Ashes of Immortality, Shining Plume) is back with a new tale involving vampires and epic fights with this great RPG.

Set in World War 2, Sudden Strike offers revolutionary real-time-strategy gameplay. Command Russian, German, French, American and British armies in large scale battles including urban warfare, beach landings and aerial invasions. Whichever tactics you choose, you will find it in Sudden Strike!
멀티플레이 AC-130 건십 로그라이트. 열화상으로 호송 차량을 사냥하고, 105mm 포탄으로 거리 전체를 무너뜨리고, 전투 중에 강화를 쌓아 무기 전체를 손에 넣으세요. 친구 셋과 분대를 꾸리거나 좀비 무리로부터 성벽을 지키세요. 그들은 당신을 볼 수 없습니다. 당신은 모든 것을 봅니다.

Control a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, rescue dogs, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies. Randomly generated for a new story and rare events every time you play!
TransOcean – The Shipping Company는 거대한 선박과 국제 운송 제국으로 들어가는 티켓입니다. 현대적인 상업 선박으로 구성된 강력한 선단을 만들고 7대양을 정복하십시오.
This is the best offer ever - 5 Hidden Object titles at one small price! Enjoy hidden object madness for 20 hours and don't forget to present this bundle to your friends who love Hidden Object Games!
Nimbatus에 명령을 내리고 수백 가지 다양한 부품으로 드론을 제작하십시오. 완전히 파괴 가능한 절차적 생성 우주에서 미지의 위협에서 생존하거나, 경기장에서 다른 플레이어와 경쟁하거나, 샌드박스에서 완전한 창조의 자유를 누리십시오.
Samorost 3 (사모로스트 3)는 탐사 어드벤처 & 퍼즐 게임으로, 인기 수상작인 Machinarium (머시나리움)과 Botanicula (보타니큘라)의 제작자들이 만든 작품입니다. 우주 공간을 여행하며 다채로운 도전과 생명체, 놀라움이 기다리는 9개의 세상을 탐험하십시오. 아름다운 아트워크와 사운드, 음악이 생동감을 더해줍니다.

en: A grande bagunça espacial - The big space mess
ko: A grande bagunça espacial - The big space mess
desc: Hello everyone! Welcome to the craziest adventure of your lives! The fearless Waldisglédson will face creatures from space and find allies on his journey!

One day, Ciarán starts receiving enigmatic emails from a mysterious sender, turning his everyday life into a mess of a romantic comedy with psychological themes mixed in. What lies beyond the mystery he's been presented with? In the words of Harry H.: "If you want to know the truth, go find it".
꼭 플레이해 봐야 하는 게임, 신규 3D 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임, The House of Da Vinci를 시작하세요.

Serious Sam 3 VR: BFE is a virtual reality action shooter, a glorious throwback to the golden age of first-person shooters where men were men, cover was for amateurs and pulling the trigger made things go boom.
악마의 군단이 에워싼 마을의 젊은 닌자가 일족의 생존을 위해 두루마리를 전달하는 임무를 부여받고 이 저주받은 세계를 모험합니다. 짜릿함과 놀라움, 그리고 공포로 가득 찬 시간여행 액션 플랫포머 어드벤처를 경험해보세요.
전설들의 연합! 다이내믹한 듀오 배트맨과 로빈이 고담 시티가 악명 높은 빌런 렉스 루터와 조커의 손에 파괴되는 것을 막기 위해, 슈퍼맨, 원더 우먼, 그리고 그린 랜턴을 포함한 DC 유니버스의 다른 유명한 슈퍼 히어로들과 합류합니다.

A ground-based RTS prequel to the classic Homeworld games. Assemble your fleet and lead them to victory on the shifting sands of Kharak in this compelling strategy game for PC from Blackbird Interactive.
Tighten the ranks on your path to glorious victories in Allods Online! Team up with your friends to explore the dangers of the mysterious Astral. Together you will prevail!

기계공이 되어 사람들을 돕고 싶어하던 소녀, 로빈. 하지만 정식 자격증이 없다는 이유로 "어머님"에 의해 죄인으로 간주된다. 로빈이 렌치를 든 이후로 세상은 이상하지고 말았다. 로빈은 세상을 원래대로 되돌리고 싶다고 생각하지만, 사랑하는 사람들이 차례로 "천벌"을 받게 되고, 조직의 요원들이 그녀를 추적한다. 하지만, 그 배후에는 무언가 더 커다란 일이 일어나고 있는 것 같았다. 아이보리라는 연료 부족과 사람들끼리의 분쟁보다도 더 큰 무언가였다. 로빈은 그 일에 휘말린 것이었다.
"Age of Gladiators"는 고대 로마의 피비린내 나는 검투사 경기가 한창일 때를 배경으로 하는 싱글 플레이어 전략/경영 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 파이터의 레벨이 올라감에 따라 그들의 속성과 능력을 어떻게 만들어 나갈지 결정하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
미니멀한 논리 퍼즐: 끊기지 않는 선 하나를 그려 타일 색을 바꾸고 보드 전체를 한 가지 색으로 맞추세요. 일반 모드와 타임 모드 192개 퍼즐, 특수 타일, 다양한 해법.

Enjoy Disney Infinity with a Full Toy Box! Disney Infinity 1.0: Gold Edition gives you the freedom to create stories and play experiences with all Disney Infinity 1.0 Characters and Playsets Unlocked and ready for you to mix, match and mash up to invent just about any adventure you can imagine.

Lured to a remote island, you find yourself confined within the rooms of an ominous mansion. You must draw upon all your puzzle-solving ability to navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”. Do you have what it takes to escape?

Act of Aggression – Reboot Edition brings the techno-thriller RTS game Act of Aggression to a higher level. The Reboot Edition offers a full gameplay overhaul in skirmish mode against the AI and in your multiplayer battles.

Meet Yoku, the pint-sized postman protagonist of Yoku's Island Express! Use a unique blend of pinball mechanics, platforming and open world exploration to unlock the secrets of Mokumana Island, help the locals, awaken ancient deities and much more in this amazing new tropical adventure!

DEAD IN BERMUDA is a survival management game with RPG and adventure elements. Lead a team of 8 survivors from a plane crash. Assign them to tasks, gain experience, develop your survival skills, research and craft new items, explore the island and solve its mysteries.

The Adventure Pals is an epic adventure platformer fueled by imagination, friendship, and the dark side of hot dogs. Your dad has been dadnapped and you, your pet rock, and a tongue-helicoptering giraffe must fight your way through levels filled with platforming, bizarre enemies, and big bosses to save the world!

Honour, sacrifice, betrayal… Your choices make you who you are. How will history remember you? Choose your friends and enemies carefully in a game where every decision has far-reaching consequences, and where finishing the game is just the beginning of your journey…

Start your even more exciting career as law enforcer on Europe’s fastest road now with the successor to the popular Autobahn Police Simulator. For the first time in Autobahn Police Simulator 2 you can use the Character Creator to customize your own in-game character.
당신만의 초대형 백화점을 디자인하고 건축하고 관리하세요. 구멍가게부터, 슈퍼마켓, 음식점, 영화관, 볼링장 등 다양한 가게를 열어보세요. 최고의 직원을 고용하고 관리해서 고객님들의 지갑을 텅 비게 만드세요!

IronWolf VR is a roomscale submarine game playable either singleplayer or online co-op with motion controls. Built from the ground up for VR, each part of the submarine has been crafted for an optimal VR experience.

Insanely addictive, easy to learn, impossible to master! Airport Madness is an airport strategy game. Designed by real air traffic controllers, Airport Madness captures the fun aspects of air traffic control. The decisions and actions you make in this game are identical to real-world airport ops.

Imperia Online brings you into a world, which exists in the times before the age of gunpowder. It is the world of the sharp blade, long bow and war horse. Experience the vast amount of gameplay mechanics and compete with thousands of players in a totally realistic medieval strategic simulation!
Command your own fortress in FTL-like real-time battles! Crush the enemy fortress with unrelenting bombardment or seize it with carefully executed invasion.
Fruit Ninja 세계로 들어가서, 새로운 가상 현실의 일부분을 체험해보세요. Fruit Ninja VR을 지금 플레이하세요!
Dashoot: ABYA’s Adventure는 픽셀 아트 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 부유 포로 스위치를 쏘고 발판을 움직이세요. 아이템을 모아 횟수, 방향, 거리가 각기 다른 대시를 사용하세요. 지하 세계의 경로를 설계하고 발전소를 재가동하며 AI Deus의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

Enjoy Disney Infinity with a Full Toy Box! Disney Infinity 2.0: Gold Edition invites you to enter the worlds of Disney Storytelling and Marvel Adventures with all Disney Infinity 2.0 Characters and Playsets Unlocked to enjoy experiences only Disney, Marvel, and your imagination can bring to life.
" Nightingale: 나이팅게일"의 신비롭고 위험한 페이 렐름에 오신것을 환영합니다. 용감한 렐름 워커가 되어 혼자 혹은 친구들과 함께 모험을 떠나보세요! 빅토리아식 판타지 월드에서 탐험하면서 제작부터 건설 그리고 전투까지 모든 것을 즐길 수 있습니다.

One of the most acclaimed adventure games of all time is now back, better than ever. Grim Fandango Remastered has the all the beautiful art and engaging story fans remember, but has also been remastered to look, sound, and control even better than the award-winning original release.

An animated visual novel of a lovely and bittersweet tale of youth, you play as Aoi Minase in this romantic-comedy as he meets various young girls in his hometown and works together with them to revive their school’s glider-flying “Soaring Club” in order to realize their shared dream of flight.
Uncover the dark secrets of a cave with an endless supply of monsters and loot!

The Takeover is a side-scrolling beat'em up inspired by 90's classics such as Streets of Rage and Final Fight. Battle solo or alongside a friend in local co-op while listening to awesome tunes from Little V Mills, Richie Branson, James Ronald and industry legend Yuzo Koshiro!

Place candles. Light a wick. Burn it all down. Hot Wax is a fresh new take on classic falling block puzzlers, where creating chain reactions is key to performing successful incantations. The temple and its eldritch resident await you, eagerly.
화려한 3D 환경에 펼쳐지는 숨가쁘게 진행되는 퍼즐 모험에 빠져보세요. 비밀 금고와 숨겨진 방들에 수수께끼로 가득한 대규모 고대 성을 탐험해야 합니다. 정교한 퍼즐을 풀고, 사라진 보물을 찾아내고, 과학과 마법이 연결된 미스터리를 파헤치세요.

Take a ride on a huge 200m (600ft) swing with breathtaking views or try other height challenges! A vast modern city is your playground. Height and speed are your passion. Ultimate height experience for VR!

Shapelab is a unique VR 3D modeling application offering an intuitive interface and a variety of powerful polygon mesh-based sculpting tools to create high-quality 3D assets. Add VR to your 3D modeling workflow and experience a new dimension of creativity with Shapelab!

SCP: 5K is a co-op or singleplayer tactical horror FPS project that puts players in the midst of a conspiracy where the SCP Foundation has turned on humanity. Enjoy Early Access as we continue to work towards a completed full release of the project!

Experience a lovely adventuring RPG. Build a ship and set sail across sunny islands to rescue your beloved sister from pirates. Explore picturesque lands, lend a helping hand to those in need, and enjoy a wholesome journey at your own pace.
The ultimate wargame set in the age of Pike and Shot is back. You are now in full charge of your nation’s armies, throughout a long campaign in the struggle for dominance.

You are Yomi, an ancient fox spirit. Your dungeon has been stolen from you while you have been sealed away in a deep sleep. Capture monster girls, collect loot, explore the dungeon's depths and reclaim what is yours in this first-person RPG dungeon crawler.

Kidnapped for no clear reason to a dazzling yet mysterious island on the Mediterranean Sea, a young girl has to find a way to escape. Armed with only her wits, agility, and the will to stay alive, she must make her getaway or Die Young.
Design your car from scratch: from the frame to the suspension and race it!

Da Capo 3 R is a visual novel set in a secret magic school hidden beneath the city of London. This slice-of-life story will blossom into a tale of love, romance, and friendship as the students overcome the magic trials that await.
고대 행성 타워 디펜스는 정통 타워 디펜스 게임입니다. 고대 문명의 요새가 외계 침략자들로부터 침략당했습니다. 고대의 강력한 기술을 사용하여 적군의 공격을 물리치십시오!

DvDrum is a realistic, customizable Drum Simulator Software with high-quality Studio Sound. Build, Learn, Play your Virtual Drums in Real-Time using MIDI, Keyboard, Pedals, Pads, Drumkits. Expand content with your own or 3000 Steam Workshop items, including sounds, images, drumkits & Drumless Tracks

en: Songs for a Hero - Definitive Edition
ko: Songs for a Hero - Definitive Edition
desc: A classic platform with a twist: A dynamic soundtrack and funny lyrics that sings the player's actions and responds to what is happening during the adventure.
Ultimate Arena is a competitive first person shooter arena game.

In Morphblade you move around a grid slicing, smashing and bursting waves of nasty red bugs. Each tile you move to transforms you into a different weapon: on a Blades hex you can slice enemies on either side of you, on an Arrow you can launch yourself through two enemies in a row.

3D Realms, creators of Duke Nukem 3D, Prey, and Max Payne, team up with Voidpoint to bring back the legendary Build Engine, famous for classic shooters like Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, and Blood. Fast-paced FPS combat across huge, secret-packed levels. Ion Fury is the real deal!
테라포밍과 제작이 함께하는 기지 건설 서바이벌 게임. 일만 년 전, 외계 세력의 침공과 함께 지구는 오염되고 버려졌습니다. 냉동 수면에서 깨어난 플레이어는 취약한 거점을 방어하고, 인류가 돌아와 살아갈 수 있도록 죽은 세계를 복원해야 합니다.
Blackguards 2 는 턴제 기반 전략과 역할 수행 게임의 속편이며, 폭력과 범죄로 가득한 전장의 이야기를 전개해 나갑니다.
Phoenix Force는 보스라는 거대하고 막강한 적군과 싸우는 Phoenix 군단이 주인공인 슈팅 게임으로 100단계로 되어 있습니다. 각 단계마다 진지를 구축하기 위해 보스 배틀을 벌여야 하며 고난이도 단계에서 짧은 배틀을 거쳐야만 사람들을 울릴 수 있습니다.

Challenge the darkness with your swift orb matching skills, mighty magical enchantments and earthshaking powerups. Match the orbs before they fall into the abyss and find your way through mysterious lands of startling beauty!
Become the sports manager of a professional cycling team and take part in a great 2016 season that will let you travel the world in over 200 cycling events.

The Sacred Stone has been stolen. Your parents have been killed. Learn the truth about yourself. Wield Magic, Wield a sword, Fight countless Enemies, Monsters Boss fights, explore open worlds, side quests and more. Enemy Combat is fast paced.
Pixel Puzzles 2: Christmas는 축제 스타일의 전통적인 스타일의 직소 퍼즐 게임입니다.
BatMUD is a text-based medieval fantasy massively multiplayer online game with an extremely rich set of features - constantly in development since 1990.
The miserable journey of a broken man...

Pioneer a living world full of warmth, heroism, and mystery. Help a small group of settlers build a home for themselves in a forgotten land. Establish a food supply, build shelter, defend your people, monitor their moods, and find a way to grow and expand, facing challenges at every step.
Qubicle is a professional voxel editor optimized for the easy creation of 3D models with a unique, blocky charm.

en: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Father
ko: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Father®
desc: Gabriel Knight is the last in a long line of Shadow Hunters, those fated to fight the dark forces of the supernatural.
두 가지 서로 다른 이야기를 중심으로 하는 3인칭 탐험 게임입니다. 주인공인 여우가 잃어버린 가족을 찾는 동안 누군가의 아들은 알래스카의 아버지를 찾아 나섭니다. 아들의 삶에서 유물을 발견함으로써 퍼스트 트리를 향한 여우의 여정 이야기가 서로 맞물리게 됩니다.

ko: 天命奇御二 Fate Seeker II
desc: Following the previous one, “Fate Seeker II” character development, thinking and exploration and other elements. You can experience real-time combat without switching scenes, and feel the delightful martial arts anytime.

Get behind the wheel of 13 realistic city buses licensed by known city bus manufacturers such as Mercedes-Benz and MAN. Keep an eye on the traffic code and drive your passengers safely to their destinations through five characteristic city districts.
Rogue Legacy의 제작자들이 진정한 협동 액션 RPG로 돌아왔습니다. FULL METAL FURIES는 팀 플레이에 중점을 둔 유니크한 전투 시스템을 보여줍니다. 팀원 모두가 누구 한 명 빠짐없이 중요하죠. 소파에서 싱글 플레이를 하거나 친구들과 함께 즐기세요. 최대 4명까지 온라인 플레이도 가능합니다!

Embark on a journey through the Old Kingdom in Realms of Magic - a sandbox RPG where you customize your character, choose your path, and immerse yourself in the fantasy world as a knight, wizard, miner, lumberjack, farmer, and more. After all, this is YOUR adventure.

전설적인 개발자 이나후네 케이지와 Metroid Prime 제작팀이 신세대 대작 액션 어드벤처 게임 "ReCore: Definitive Edition"으로 돌아옵니다. 마지막 인류 중 한 명으로서 용감한 로봇 그룹과 우호를 다지고, 그들과 함께 기이하고 역동적인 세상 속으로 신나는 모험을 떠나세요! 새로운 "흑요석의 눈" 모험과 "T8-NK" 코어봇 프레임 포함!
실제 눈 깜박임을 이용하여 스토리와 결과를 조작하는 감성적인 1인칭 내러티브 어드벤처를 시작하세요. 이 혁신적인 기술을 통해 당신의 인생 전체가 눈앞에서 빛나는 것처럼, 즐겁고 가슴 아픈 기억의 세계에 완전히 빠져들게 될 것입니다.

Before Chip can join the Bit Busters computer club and hang out with the girl of his dreams, Melinda the Mental Marvel, he must solve all 144 challenging puzzles. Your bird's-eye view can help Chip rush through the puzzles and mazes before he's deleted by monsters, traps and the passage of time.

FlatOut 4: Total Insanity™, where reckless driving has never been this much fun. FlatOut 4: Total Insanity™ blends everything everyone has ever loved about FlatOut into one offering. Gamers will also be introduced to all new and exciting features, game modes, and vehicles which will soon become personal favorites.

en: The Beast Within: A Gabriel Knight Mystery
ko: The Beast Within: A Gabriel Knight® Mystery
desc: Play as both Gabriel and Grace as they are dispatched to Munich to solve a series of mutilation murders thought to be the work of werewolves.
Introducing Chess Ultra; the most breathtaking chess game ever made. Experience stunning 4K visuals, seamless online multiplayer, Grandmaster approved AI and full VR compatibility.

Wanderland, the mystery adventure from Artogon, the world-famous creator of great casual adventures series such as Shiver, Treasure Seekers and Depths of Betrayal. Sleeping Beauty has been kidnapped! Explore a world full of temples, crypts, and more.
Repel the Rifts는 로그라이트 타워 디펜스 게임입니다. 외계 행성에서 지휘관을 이끌고 각 공세마다 새로운 지형을 탐색하며, 강력한 업그레이드를 골라가며, 방어 시설을 건설하여 혼돈을 막아내세요.

Guns, Gore & Cannoli - An over-the-top, comical and fast-paced action game with hand-drawn graphics set in the Roaring Twenties. An all-you-can-shoot fest where you embody Vinnie, a mobster with a mission in a city controlled by gangsters and plagued by zombies. Featuring up to 4-man local co-op.
Explore Arctico with your dog sled, kayak, and up to 3 friends! Build and customize your base camp, gather resources and samples, set up labs, and take good care of your dogs in this peaceful island.
Developed in America and first released in 1981, Ms. PAC-MAN finally comes to Steam! Move Ms. PAC-MAN up, down, left, and right to avoid the ghosts and gobble up all the Pac-Dots!

Take part in major WWII battles in Battle Islands: Commanders, from the sandy dunes of North Africa to the bitter cold of the Eastern Front! Master the art of war against real opponents from around the world and reap the spoils of war.

Lead a team of cloned settlers and build a home on a new planet. Start from the Stone Age, construct sturdy shelters, hunt for food, and fight off dangers. Make your team stronger and better equipped to survive.

You ARE Octogeddon, a massive mutant octopus with one mission: DESTROY the world! Grow more tentacles and evolve each of them into deadlier and deadlier weapons until you become the ultimate eight-legged killing machine!

A skateboarding game for tony hawk series fans! Over 70 various goals to beat in over 8 big levels! This game has all it needs for a complete skateboarding experience: - Over 30 tricks to beat - get special and make some special tricks - manuals and grinds with balance meter - secret gaps to find - combine tricks in big combos - do spine...
바이킹이 돌아온다!
어떤 노래든 플레이할 수 있는 리듬 코스로 바꿔 보세요! 좋아하는 음악을 가져오거나, 라이브 오디오 모드로 PC에서 재생되는 소리에 맞춰 플레이하세요. 인디 아티스트의 공식 트랙을 즐기고, 순위표에 도전하고, 레벨 에디터로 나만의 레벨을 만들고, Steam 창작마당에서 커뮤니티 레벨을 찾아보세요.
RAID: World War II is an action-packed four player cooperative shooter set during a time when the Nazi war machine was still winning, and hope was in short supply.

Spellweaver is a free-to-play digital card game true to the classics of the genre, adding in several unique features for a new and fresh gameplay experience. With a focus of strategic depth and variety, it offers endless hours of fun in casual or AI matches, ranked play, drafts, and tournaments!
What happens when someone has no magic in a world where everyone has it? Play this quirky, colorful 16-bit style RPG and find out!
마법주문 드래프팅과 멋진 수염을 뽐내는 마법 싸움꾼, MageQuit은 온라인상 10명의 마법사 또는 오프라인에서 명까지 플레이가 가능합니다. 각 킬수가 증가할 때마다 수염이 더 길게 자랍니다. 9라운드 후에 가장 긴 수염을 가진 마법사가 승리하게 됩니다!
지구에서 가장 성공한 U-Tuber의 주인공이 되어보세요! 영상을 제작하고 구독자 수를 늘려가며, 이벤트에 참석하거나 팬들과 교류하는 등... 채널을 키워나가세요. U-Tuber의 삶을 살아보는 거예요!
Airline Tycoon Deluxe는 실시간으로 진행되는 재미있는 경제 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 항공사에 대한 모든 책임을 사용자에게 부여합니다.

Survive the zombie apocalypse with a “Final Fantasy” turn-based combat and permanent death! Manage survivors, craft materials, and make difficult decisions. Defend your camp against hordes of the undead to prevail in this non-linear rogue-lite (comparable to FTL). Innovative Indie Survival-RPG!

One gloomy night, Bulb Boy wakes suddenly from a frightening nightmare to discover that evil has overshadowed the Bulbhouse. His family has disappeared and there are horrid monsters lurking in the shadows. Gather the courage and use his glass head to save everything he loves.
머쉬룸 워 2(Mushroom Wars 2)에서 거침없는 머쉬룸 군단의 적대 부족들은 짧지만 치열한 전략 시뮬레이션 게임의 전투에서 마주하고 있습니다. 두려움을 모르는 머쉬룸 사령관이 되어 군대를 이끌어갈 영웅을 선택하고 다양한 멀티 플레이어 모드나 도전적인 스토리 캠페인을 통해서 전장을 장악하세요.

MX Nitro: Unleashed invites you to blaze into motocross racing nirvana. The game expands upon the original MX Nitro with new tracks, new bosses, and new outfits! The game also includes several improvements from the original including improved visuals.

Playing Monsti is easy, all you have to do is to click and fly for as much time as you can. There will be many obstacles that come your way and you have to do all in your power in order to avoid them.

Explore 6 x 6 x 6 = 216 rooms of randomly generated hazards and enemies while collecting the necessary artefacts. Hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards — the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner.

en: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
ko: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: HELP WANTED
desc: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.
UnderRail is an old-school turn-based isometric role-playing game that features a large open post-apocalyptic world, deep and challenging combat and an intricate storyline.
Doodle God은 헤어날 수 없는 퍼즐 및 세계 건설 게임으로 플레이어가 논리와 독창성을 사용해 우주 전체를 창조해요. 이 모든 연령이 즐길 수 있는 중독적인 퍼즐 게임에서, 불, 흙, 물 그리고 공기를 다양하게 섞고 결합해 우주를 창조하세요!

Try and survive in the world of Nomad. Build a base and protect it from raiding players. Scavenge food, weapons and medical supplies across the island. Team up with others and make a base. Make your mark on the world of Nomad.

The non-PC buxom shinobi of SENRAN KAGURA, the brawler series that’s as over-the-top with its fighting mechanics as it is with its gratuitous depictions of female ninja in various forms of undress, invade the PC realm for the first time in HD and 60fps glory.
You are a guy with a backpack, just try to stay alive!

RPG World – THE Action RPG Maker! Unleash your imagination with RPG World and create, share and play amazing 3D games with our growing community. Claim glory and treasure as you conquer magical worlds, alone or as a team. No coding required!
'항해의 시대'호의 선장이되어 선원들을 지휘하고, 내 결정에 따라 반응하는 방대한 스토리로 이루어진 세계를 탐험하세요. 고전적인 유화 스타일로 꾸며진 바다에서 적의 함선, 요새 및 바다 몬스터와 잔혹한 전술 전투를 벌이세요.

KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

Way of the Samurai 4 takes place in the humble port town of Amihama during the mid 19th Century, several years after the arrival of the “black ships” from the West ended Japan’s long history of cultural isolation.
터보 차지 핀볼의 귀환! 더 많은 스프라이트와 난관, 비밀, 그리고 탄환이 쏟아집니다! Demon's Tilt는 슈팅과 핵 앤 슬래시 요소를 도입하여 비디오 핀볼 게임 장르의 한계에 도전합니다.

en: Space Pilgrim Episode II: Epsilon Indi
ko: Space Pilgrim Episode II: Epsilon Indi
desc: One year after the events of Episode I, Captain Pilgrim is once again carrying a shipload of passengers between star systems. This time her guests include a mysterious priestess, a wayward youth and a robotics genius.

Walk the thin, blue line in four of the most realistic crime games ever created, packed with complex storylines and real-life mysteries that only a handful of real police officers ever face - or solve.
PCMark 10은 자사 산업 표준 PC 벤치마크 시리즈의 최신 버전입니다. 윈도우 10을 위한 새롭고 향상된 테스트가 업데이트된 PCMark 10은 더 빠르고 사용이 간편합니다. 윈도우 PC를 위한 완벽한 벤치마크입니다.

Build a city, Create an Empire! Research 400+ technologies, and Build 70+ buildings, Craft and Trade 380+ items in an entirely player driven market. Fight Wars and Forge Alliances with thousands of players and create your own Empire in this award-winning, critically-acclaimed MMO.
Run an adventurers shop – a serious business in a fantasy environment. Stock your store with dangerous weapons, fancy hats, sturdy armour and magical potions.
풍경을 조합하여 친절하고 오싹한 친구들과 유령들을 위해 괴물의 낙원을 만드는 아늑하고 편안한 퍼즐 게임, 팽토피아에 푹 빠져 보세요. 걱정도 두려움도 없는, 잔잔한 오싹함으로 가득한 세계를 설계해 보세요.
Online shooter with a variety of game modes and a huge arsenal of weapons. Fight with other players, or team up with them to defeat hordes of zombies and mutants!

놀라운 스피드와 스타일리쉬한 환경 속에서 음악과 함께 에너지를 뿜어내는 빛나는 리본을 따라가 보세요. 수상한 적과 무시무시한 보스와의 싸움에 허가를 받은 멋진 사운드트랙이 함께합니다. 인디 스튜디오 'Mad Fellow'가 당신을 'Noisia,Flux Pavilion, Katy B, The Prototypes, Neosignal' 외 많은 밴드가 사운드에 참여한 독특하고 혁신적인 게임 세상 속으로 안내할 것입니다.

An explosive combination of mining sim and city builder. Your dream of building your own thriving town starts with few explosive charges and a yellow truck. As you mine the landscape and the money starts to roll in you'll be able to expand your empire, buying buildings, shops and facilities.

en: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
ko: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
desc: Welcome to Circus Baby's Pizza World, where family fun and interactivity go beyond anything you've seen at those *other* pizza places! Now hiring: Late night technician. Must enjoy cramped spaces and be comfortable around active machinery. Not responsible for death or dismemberment.
새로 변신하여 하늘을 날고 탐험하며, 활기가 넘치는 하늘의 떠다니는 섬 세계를 경험하세요. 잃어버린 고대 유적지로 모험을 떠나, 세상의 끝에 한 발 더 가까이 다가가세요.

An old-fashioned beat 'em up with big doses of adrenaline and trippiness, somewhere between the classic style of Streets of Rage and the ultra-violence of Hotline Miami. Set in a cold, ruthless Soviet Union, Mother Russia Bleeds aims to conjure up anxiety, unease, and drug-addled frenzy.

Play with the most celebrated flying cat in human history. Drink milk, eat ice-cream, collect coins, buy gorgeous boosts, fly like a superhero (sorry... supercat), jump onto platforms made of cake, avoid angry dogs, and discover the infinite space.

Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Eat rats, dinosaurs, gladiators, samurai, pyramids, volcanoes... Everything! Soon you'll be eating the entire planet.

en: Dark Parables: The Final Cinderella Collector's Edition
ko: Dark Parables: The Final Cinderella Collector's Edition
desc: Foil the evil Godmother's plans!
Gravel is the ultimate off-road experience. The most extreme racing game that will let you try out amazing stunts in the wildest places on the planet!
Tell Me Why는 DONTNOD Entertainment가 제작한 여러 수상 실적이 있는 에피소드 기반의 어드벤처 게임입니다. 쌍둥이들이 그들의 초자연적인 유대 능력으로 문제가 많았던 과거의 진실을 밝혀나갑니다.

en: Pajama Sam: No Need to Hide When It's Dark Outside
ko: Pajama Sam: No Need to Hide When It's Dark Outside
desc: There's no reason to be afraid of the dark. Fed up with his fear of the dark, Sam transforms himself into Pajama Sam - world's youngest superhero and resolves to confront Darkness! With help from King the mine car, Otto the boat, and a host of fascinating characters.

Build railways, manage traffic and stay accident-free. Play in Europe, America, Japan and USSR in 1830-2020. Complete the story mode from the Gold Rush of 1849 to the first manned spaceflight, and then explore the random mode. Management. Construction. Trains. Welcome to Train Valley!
“METAL SLUG 2”, the 2nd entry in SNK’s emblematic 2D run & gun action shooting game returns to the battlefield on the Steam gaming platform!

The sequel to Planet Alcatraz tells the story of sergeant Hartman, the leader of the Ghoul strike unit, that remained MIA in the original game. Only Russian language is supported at the time of Steam release.
――혼전＜밀리＞를 제압하라. 완전히 새로운 "게임성・엔터테인먼트성" 그리고 "경쟁성" 을 실현하는 그 밀리 액션이 STEAM에 참전!!

Uprising offers more strategy than a military sim, and more action strategy than a shoot'em up. Using your hi-tech assault tank, loaded with powerful weapons, you need to establish tidal bases, mine for power, build factories and direct legions of allied units against the enemy
마법 지팡이를 사용해 서로이어진 거대한 세상을 탐험하며 퍼즐을 풀고, 적들과 싸우고 보스를 물리쳐 알와의 땅을 자유롭게 해 주세요. 당신의 점프 스킬을 사용해 도전적이고 멋진 8비트 어드벤처에서 비밀을 밝혀 보세요.

Hunt humans, slay dinosaurs. Choose your side in chaotic prehistoric PvP... newly updated with more dinosaurs, more weaponry, new game mechanics, expanded lore and more! Think fast, or you're extinct.

A sandbox crafting adventure with quests, magic, automation, and exploration. Gather resources, build your base, unlock new technologies, and shape your own path through a world full of secrets and progression. Inspired by Yogscast and classic Minecraft modpacks with many new and unique features.

King’s Quest is a collection of five different chapter releases, each focusing on an untold tale in Graham’s past. Discover a wondrous world full of whimsical characters, charming puzzles and perilous dangers in this fun and enchanting coming of age story.

Merging the smash hit indie game The Escapists with the world wide phenomenon that is The Walking Dead, Team17 have taken the very best of both worlds and are now providing players with the opportunity to play Rick Grimes as he takes on hordes of zombies let loose upon the world.
Mimpi가 가는 길의 모든 것에 오줌을 누어 친구들을 구하도록 그를 도우십시오! 아니요, 심각하게, 이 게임에서 체크포인트에 오줌을 누어 Mimpi의 진행 상황을 저장할 수 있습니다. 꿈을 맞추는 6개의 다른 레벨을 통한 플랫폼에서 이 개 모험을 꿈꿉니다. 이 비현실에서 편히 지내고, 캐주얼한 그림은 생생하게 나옵니다.

The Dark Legions is a 3d real-time strategy game in the medieval ages. You can command your army and build your empire through story driven missions. Or you can prove your strength against computer players, on randomly generated missions.

「프린세스 메이커 2 리파인」은, 그 시리즈 중에서도 아시아 시장에서 기록적인 대 히트를 기록해 높은 인기를 구가했던 시리즈 대표작 「프린세스 메이커 2」의 리메이크 작으로 플레이어는 별의 신에게 천계의 소녀를 인도받아, 아버지로서 무사히 10세부터 18세까지 길러내는 것이 목적입니다. 딸을 키우면서 다양한 아르바이트와 수업을 통한 세세한 파라메터 설정과 함께, 플레이어를 서포트하는 시리즈의 인기 캐릭터인 집사 「큐브」의 등장, 무사수행에서의 수많은 이벤트 등, 커다란 볼륨을 자랑합니다. 딸의 꿈은 프린세스이지만, 키우는 방법에 따라 다양한 미래가 기다리고 있습니다.
한나라가 쇠미해지고, 영웅들이 등장했다. 옛날 천하는 이미 무너진 장기판처럼 산산조각나고, 더 이상 정해진 판세는 없다. 강산은 판, 중생은 말. 연기가 자욱한 삼국 난세로 들어가, 군사를 통솔하고 진형을 배치하며, 영웅들이 노리는 가운데 적을 격파하고 성을 점령하며 천하를 다퉈라!

en: One Piece: Unlimited World Red - Deluxe Edition
ko: One Piece: Unlimited World Red - Deluxe Edition
desc: 50개가 넘는 DLC로 “언리미티드” 시리즈가 새롭게 재탄생했습니다

Medieval Engineers is a sandbox game about engineering, construction and the maintenance of architectural works and mechanical equipment using medieval technology. Players build castles; construct mechanical devices and underground mining. There is an entire planet to explore!
Lethis - Path of Progress is a city-builder in a victorian steampunk setting.
전설에 따르면 세상에서 제일 추운 겨울이 찾아왔을 때 요툰이 돌아와 아스가르드의 신들에게 복수할 것이라고 전해집니다. 세상은 파멸을 향해 나아가고 있고 미드가르드의 운명은 불분명하기만 합니다.
Assemble patchwork mosaics while you travel with Alice and the famous characters of Wonderland and Looking-Glass Land
Manage your very own logistics company, discover the complex world of cross-country haulage and keep the US economy up and running!

Surgeon Simulator is bringing the ER to VR! The most critically acclaimed and infamous surgery simulation game as you have never seen it before! Featuring all of the surgeries and twisted humour of the original favourite plus a few new surprises...
"Join a father on an epic journey to save his little girl's life!"

en: Umineko When They Cry - Answer Arcs
ko: Umineko When They Cry - Answer Arcs
desc: This is the 2nd half of the Umineko When They Cry sound novel series, featuring episodes 5 through 8. This steam version features multi-language options, swap-able renewed character sprites, as well as the original BGMs and un-cut content.
복잡하게 얽힌 거대한 사이버 펑크 도시 Nivalis에서 Cloudpunk의 배달부로 일한 첫날 밤, 당신에게 말해줄 자신들의 이야기를 가진 인간, AI, 안드로이드의 다양한 등장인물을 만나고 상호작용하게 될 것입니다.
화장실 가는 시간, 스크루드라이버와 핵폭발이 어우러지는 게임.
처음 만나는 인형극 RPG로 여러분을 초대합니다! 수많은 적과 싸우고 새 업그레이드를 구매하고 마법을 쓰고 새 동료를 영입하세요. 또는 알아서 싸우는 영웅들의 전투를 편하게 지켜보면서 즐기거나 다른 일을 해도 좋습니다.

THE GAME OF LIFE showcases a beautifully rendered digital game board, cards and spinner that capture the fun of the Classic game full of adventure & surprises! THE GAME OF LIFE will take players on a journey where fortunes can be won…and lost!

en: Xuan-Yuan Sword: The Gate of Firmament
ko: Xuan-Yuan Sword: The Gate of Firmament
desc: The “Xuan-Yuan Sword” is an epic oriental RPG series with 25 years of history.It elaborates on the very heart of this series, the idea of "one, looking at the same thing from different angles, may come to different conclusions. " through a variety of historical incidents in different times.

From the creative mind of Douglas Adams. The Starship Titanic crashes into your house and takes off with you onboard. Inhabited by malfunctioning robots and a semi-deranged parrot, you must gain control of the ship and pilot it back to Earth.

en: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.4 Himatsubushi
ko: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.4 Himatsubushi
desc: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

en: Jewel Quest Seven Seas Collector's Edition
ko: Jewel Quest Seven Seas Collector's Edition
desc: Jewel Quest: Seven Seas stays true to its roots - giving longtime Jewel Quest fans a “pure” jewel matching experience while delighting new players with jewel swapping tricks unique to this beloved series of games.
Harebrained Schemes' biggest Shadowrun game to date, and the definitive Shadowrun RPG experience available on PC. Now a standalone title with tons of new content & improvements!
A pixel-art sandbox with deeply customizable AI NPCs. Build, farm, explore, and fight together. Here, companionship is more than just conversation.

The first entry in the Assassin’s Creed Chronicles saga takes place in China, 1526, as the Ming dynasty starts to crumble. You embody Shao Jun, the last remaining Assassin of the Chinese Brotherhood, returning to her homeland with a vendetta.

From the makers of Sakura Spirit, Sakura Angels and Sakura Fantasy this time working together with the artist Inma to bring you this visual novel dating sim on the beach! Seiji is a daydreamer who spends too much time thinking about space.

In the world of Ivoire lives Marona, an orphan with the ability to speak with phantoms. Though shunned by society, she believes in helping others. With her phantom companion Ash, Marona aims to purchase the mysterious Phantom Isle.
Splasher는 유머와 깜짝 이벤트로 가득 찬 재미있는 2d 플랫폼 게임입니다. 페인트 캐논으로 무장한 당신은 Inkorp 메가 팩토리에서 많은 위험에 마주할 것입니다. 당신의 동료 Splasher들을 구하고, 사악한 보스인 Le Docteur의 프로젝트를 끝내십시오.
Jogue com os mascotes de Atlético MG e Cruzeiro neste jogo multiplayer de tiro em terceira pessoa!

Ancestors Legacy is a squad-based real time strategy with a strong focus on tactics. Inspired by medieval European history, it brings to life four different nations and their conflicts, usually solved by war.

The cult classic open-ended wilderness survival roguelike taking place in the ancient North, iron-age Finland. Throughout the years, UnReal World has been praised for its incredible depth, realism, atmos and immersion. Lose yourself in the most intricate, detailed and enchanting iron-age game world.

Talk to your neighbors to bring your hometown back together in a 5-chapter adventure. Explore a small town with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story. Get to know people to get them to RSVP to your festival, and read their 2000s-era websites on an in-game internet!

Classic strategy game from 2003. Run your own casino in the 1970s. It's classy. It's glitzy. It's all yours. Take a gamble. Start small with a slot machine or two. Employ some staff. People will be talking about your place from coast to coast. Includes The Management Expansion Pack.

An epic adventure in a land of monsters, traps and magic. Journey across the deadly Shamutanti Hills and through Kharé, Cityport of Thieves. Armed with your sword and over fifty spells with weird and wonderful effects, embark on a narrative adventure of a thousand choices where every one is remembered.
Dream of playing in the World Snooker Championship? Indulge your snooker fix, and play along with the televised version of the sport with Snooker Nation Championship

Card Quest is a dungeon crawling adventure game with unique card combat. Play with a variety of unique character classes, and customize decks to fit your playstyle. Explore the strategic depth of tactical roguelike gameplay, and crush the undead plague.

Outnumbered and outgunned, but not outmatched.Call of Duty®: Ghosts is an extraordinary step forward for one of the largest entertainment franchises of all-time. This new chapter in the Call of Duty® franchise features a new dynamic where players are on the side of a crippled nation fighting not for freedom, or liberty, but simply to...
Rebel Galaxy is a swashbuckling space adventure, with action-packed combat, exploration, discovery, trade, and “negotiation” with the outlandish denizens at the edge of the known universe.
Time moves when you move in a truly non-Euclidean world

Big Thinkers! Kindergarten is the perfect learning supplement to your child's classroom experience. Ben and Becky Brightly's contagious wonder and ability to transform themselves into a variety of shapes and forms engage kids in a fun world of learning and discovery!
