The Uncertain은 종말 후의 세계를 무대로 한 스토리 주도의 어드벤처 게임입니다. 신중히 각 장소를 탐색하며 신비로운 분위기를 체험하고, 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어 운명을 결정하는 선택을 통해, 흥미로운 내용에 대해 이야기를 나누며 숨겨진 진실의 전모를 알아내세요.

RefRain - prism memories - is an empowering, cyberpunk, bullet-hell shoot-’em-up that focuses on fast-paced, offensive gameplay. “Dive” into a hazardous digital world, cycle through 3 different attack modes, and delete the opposition with superior firepower.
Hadley wakes in a facility. She is 9 months pregnant. They want her baby... CAYNE is the FREE, isometric horror game from the creators of STASIS.
당신은 세계의 마지막 수호자 중 한 명은 Avil이라는 이름의 병사이며, 끝없이 몰려오는 Ravenii에게 맞서 싸울 수 있는 능력이 있습니다. 광활한 세계 속에서 도시를 방어하고 집을 잃은 난민들을 구하며 거대한 괴수들과 그 수하들에 맞서 싸우세요.
Save Atlantis by building roads, clearing debris, and gathering resources in this strategic time management game!

Oldschool FPS. Hardcore classic gameplay action. Huge hordes of monsters. Blood. Horror. Fun. Each level is unique and not similar to the previous. You need to survive in this dangerous world and become the best evil shooter.
이 짧은 단편 비주얼 노벨에서, 당신은 Ai란 소녀와 약속을 잡고 시간을 보내게 되는 '정'으로 플레이합니다. 좋은 시간 보내세요.
In this base-defense deck-building card game you and your teammates will have to work together to survive the continuous onslaught of powerful alien threats and horrors!
Minimal physical puzzle with explosions
Train Crisis는 서로 다른 색깔의 기차를 지정된 목적지로 유도하는 퍼즐 전략 게임입니다. 산업 혁명 시대, 서부 개척 시대, 현대와 미래, 총 4종류의 역사적 배경 속에서 각종 장애물을 피하고 여러분의 능력을 시험해보세요.
새로운 RPG가 여러분을 기다립니다. 혁신적인 실시간 전투와 함께 시간 정지 또는 슬로우 모션 기능을 제공하는 스토리 중심의 던전 크롤러입니다. 성공을 위해서는 전술적 사고가 필수입니다. 이제 RPGlite 및 영구 사망 모드로 빠르게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

en: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier
ko: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier™
desc: Ghost Recon Future Soldier에서 치명적인 특수부대원으로 이루어진 고도로 숙련된 정예 팀에 합류하십시오. 비할 바 없는 전투 기술로 완전 무장한 Ghost Recon이 여러분을 세상에서 가장 위험천만한 전쟁 지역으로 데려갑니다. 그곳에서 최고 가치의 목표를 쓰러뜨리십시오.

Spriter makes it easy for anyone, regardless of experience, to create 2D game animations using a technique called Modular Animation. Individual sprite pieces can be attached to bones and then easily animated with the powerful, yet easy to use toolset.

A neutral family fights for its business - and its survival - and is swept up in the struggle against the encroaching Empire. You must defy the strong-arm tactics of a rival family who will stop at nothing to destroy your trading company.

Eaten Alive is a Point and Click, Adventure, Horror game with Puzzle and Mystery game-play elements. Take control of 'Mia' six years after the apocalypse began, the dead don't stay dead and the earth is in a permanent state of darkness. This game contains adult themes.
Originally an arcade fighting game, Koihime Enbu features fast combat, tight controls, clean visuals, and 13 different playable characters!

en: The Sandbox Evolution - Craft a 2D Pixel Universe!

desc: Rise through the ranks and lead your band of Gladiators to glory. Can you build the ultimate fighting force and a kingdom to rule all! Be careful who you trust. Becoming a Gladiator Trainer isn't easy.
Dustoff 헬리콥터 구조 2에서는 다음을 할 수 있습니다. 전쟁 포로 수용소에 갇혀 있는 인질을 구조합니다. 사막과 숲, 지뢰반, 늪, 피요르드에서 공격해오는 적과 싸웁니다.

Why be good when you can be... bad? Cursed Treasure 2 is an addictive tower-defense game that puts the power of darkness at your fingertips. Build towers of powerful orcs, demons, and undead, and master powerful spells, to protect your precious hoard from all manner of no-good do-gooders.
LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 takes players through Harry Potter's heroic adventures in the Muggle and wizarding worlds.

en: Towers of Altrac - Epic Defense Battles
ko: Towers of Altrac - Epic Defense Battles
desc: Towers of Altrac is a 3D Tower Defense cooperation game for up to 4 players with an innovative A.I. system “S.A.D.”, which makes your enemies intelligent . Fight against the horde of Goblins, Orcs, Dragons and other monsters on 62 unique maps. The game is for every level of player experience.

Incandescent is a fast paced action arcade game that scales the difficulty to your skill level. The goal is simple, pilot your ship and defend yourself against waves of unique enemies and bosses. Different powerups will drop to help you with upgrades to your weapons and health.

The main purpose of this game is showing and watching machines made out of blocks. Some of the game-modes allow you to battle or race against other players. (testing phase) You can create your original machine with ease by reassembling those machines that are distributed, or by using the automatic control block.
Falcon 4.0 breaks the sight-and-sound barrier with its cutting-edge graphics, realism, dynamic campaigns and multiplayer gameplay.
An 80s-themed puzzle game in which you avoid the line of sight of lethal gun turrets... while acquiring pick-up sticks.

Dive into a virtual sci-fi world as the freelance hacker Thomas Hall to save a cyber artist that got stuck in virtual reality. Fight legions of enemy drones with your multi-functional loadout. Slow time, transform your weapon and blast through your enemies in this immersive VR shooter.
Whispers of a Machine은 후기 AI 세계에서 일련의 살인 사건을 조사하고 금지된 기술을 두고 벌이는 암흑가의 분쟁을 해결하는 인공두뇌 형사의 이야기를 들려주는 북유럽 SF 누아르 게임입니다.

en: Sea Dogs: To Each His Own
ko: Sea Dogs: To Each His Own
desc: 1654 AC. The Caribbean. A place of opportunities and mysteries.

Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!
mmdrive 소프트웨어와 함께 즉시 10,000 MB / s의 :로드 게임 @ 스팀 게임을 재생합니다. Dimmdrive 완전히 모든 스팀 게임과 통합됩니다.

The new visual novel from the makers of Sakura Spirit and Sakura Angels. Sakura Fantasy Chapter 1 is an exciting visual novel fantasy adventure where you decide the development of the story by the choices you make. It is the tale of an aspiring female protagonist who wishes to aim to become a knight.

Rogue-like FPS with strong RPG elements set in a 22nd century reality-show parody. Win a fortune or die, but never disappoint your audience. And audience is virtual or real with revolutionary but optional features for streamers and their fans.

Get ready for the rural lifestyle! This game is set on your own farm! Enjoy the life of a farmer with all its amazing tasks and challenges! Drive your original vehicles, cultivate your fields, take care of your animals and market your produce! Different seasons and weather conditions guarantee realistic game fun.

Cyberline Racing combines action packed shooting with adrenaline pumped races, delivering an explosive experience. Load your car with guns and put your driving skills to the ultimate test as you dodge missiles, destroy enemy cars, and race to the top of the online rankings!
FPS/Slasher/Horror for people with strong nerves. Tomato Way it`s like your favorite video game, but better.
Soulstorm은 혁명의 전조에 휩싸인 번잡한 사회를 배경으로 하며, 매 순간의 선택이 게임의 결과를 좌지우지하고, 여러 엔딩을 맛볼 수 있는 강렬한 액션 어드벤처 플랫폼 게임입니다.

ko: Every Day We Fight 에브리데이 위 파이트
desc: 인류의 마지막 희망은 타임 루프에 갇힌 저항군 투사들입니다. 실시간 탐험과 턴제 전술 및 로그라이트 전략과 만나, 새로운 능력을 배우고, 새로운 무기를 찾고, 새로운 기술을 개발하는 과정에서 미지의 외계 위협으로부터 살아남아야 합니다.

A New Wizardry for a New GenerationThe universe is in the throes of violent upheaval and change. Vast and mysterious forces are preparing for the final confrontation. A small group of heroes from distant lands must plunge into the heart of the maelstrom, to uncover long-forgotten secrets, and bring about a new era.

en: You Have to Win the Game
ko: You Have to Win the Game
desc: You Have to Win the Game is a free exploration platformer with a retro 1980s PC aesthetic.

새내기 FBI 요원인 앤 타버의 눈을 통해 실종 사건 수사를 직접 체험하세요. 노련한 수사관 마리아 핼퍼린과 함께 버지니아의 아름답고 외진 마을, 버제스 카운티로 떠나서 흔적도 없이 사라진 어린 소년을 찾으세요. 트윈픽스, 파고, 트루 디텍티브 스타일의 이 정통 수사물은 독특한 회화적 아트 형식과 마음을 뒤흔드는 사운드트랙과 함께 몽환적인 환경에서 펼쳐집니다.

en: It's time to get out from the solar system
ko: It's time to get out from the solar system
desc: A game with a futuristic anti-utopian story — a hardcore space shooter with RPG elements.
The epic RPG 7 Mages in the tradition of the greatest classics of the genre takes you around the magical island of Roven.

You wake up to the smell of rotting flesh in what can only be described as someone's basement. Your memory is blank and your vision impaired, you have no idea where you are. The floors and walls are dirty, it appears there may be other people here as there are dirty sheets on the floor.

A company is currently in development of robots for the new generation - Botology, conduct tests for a new system for the remote control of robots. The purpose of the company is to help future potential buyers explore the remote space systems.
Experience your epic journey. Discover 20 mysterious lands and face the monsters living out there. Show that you are persistent traveler and held your adventure, even in the toughest conditions.

Mad Bullets, the wackiest shooter is here to put your reflexes and laughing muscles to an intensive test. You can forget about boring stories, complicated controls and irritating tutorials, and jump right into a mind blowing, high-speed action.

When you sleep, you are dreaming. Some dreams are beautiful and vivid, the others are strange, and the rest of them are horrible... We've having them all the night, and then wake up and forget them. But what if one day your "awakening" would be a difficult task? Could you find a way out of the dreams and wake up?

Summer, 2020, Ya'issor. Most people have become youtubers, streamers, and other scum, and almost no one wants to be a working bum. Nobody has an opinion of their own. Everyone thinks they are nihilists, atheists, reading intellectuals, and other elites.
Survive through four days at the end of the world in this post-apocalyptic point-and-click thriller where your choices could keep you alive... or not.
Homefront®: The Revolution is an open-world first person shooter where you must lead the Resistance movement in guerrilla warfare against a superior military force.
The Pasture gives you a truly innovative gameplay and experimental possibilities that will allow you to experience yourself as a different character – a member of mysterious modern art elite.

When a tragic turn of events sets one man down a path of supernatural chaos and revenge, he must brutally hunt down all those who wronged him. Fight and survive through 8 unique story-based scenarios, and try your hand at 40 individually designed turn-based combat missions

Railroad management and City Development simulation game, A-Train 8 keeps the strong mechanics of the A-Train series with the whole map in 3D for the first time. A game to both control a 3D city, and enjoy watching the landscape you helped create.This game is only available in Japanese.
Pick and create characters to fight to the death in this action-packed nonsensical arena simulation.

A zombie outbreak eradicated all hope of returning life back to normal, now only survival lives on. Run, hide and fight your way through the undead as Randall searches for his family in this gorgeous, gritty, destroyed world.

This rich fantasy world loved by fans for its deep tactics and epic stories is due to become that much larger once the upcoming Ratmen enter the fold, bringing with it a brand new, meaty mainline quest for fans to battle through. But like any good adventure, it's never really over!
Master storyteller Roberta Williams challenges you to experience the ultimate interactive nightmare.

Vaporum is a grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in an original steampunk setting, inspired by old-school classics of the genre. Stranded in the middle of an ocean, in front of a gigantic tower, the hero has to find out what the place is, what happened there, and most importantly, who he is.
Get the complete GalCiv II saga including Galactic Civilizations II: Dread Lords, the expansion pack Dark Avatar, and the newest expansion pack Twilight of the Arnor!

en: On The Road - The Truck Simulator
ko: ON THE ROAD - The Truck Simulator
desc: From 18 tonners to the Gigaliner, ON THE ROAD – The Truck Simulator offers everything a trucker’s heart desires.
A magic world, epic heroes, bright graphics, excellent humor and absorbing gameplay – “Three Heroes”!

Anarchy Online – the first ever science fiction MMO – is now on Steam! Compete and cooperate with thousands of players simultaneously on a vast, alien world. Join humanity nearly 30,000 years in the future in a world of perpetual conflict and scientific marvel.

en: Aselia the Eternal -The Spirit of Eternity Sword-
ko: Aselia the Eternal -The Spirit of Eternity Sword-
desc: With his sister Kaori held hostage, Yuuto must fight as an Etranger, a warrior of power, and take up the sword to fight alongside the beautiful female Spirits who protect the land from an evil that threatens to consume it.

Turbo Pug is back! And this time, he's three dimensional! Join Turbo Pug and friends, sprint your way through a randomly generated voxel world with scaling difficulty. Turbo Pug 3D - Fast paced, casual fun.

Vendor Chronicles puts you in the shoes of a Vendor in post-apocalyptia! Manage your trade, set your defences, deal with locals and fight hordes of mutants in this new perspective on post-apocalyptic survival!

테라 미스티카라고 불리는 판타지 세계에서 14개의 종족이 힘과 영토를 얻기 위해 서로, 때로는 함께 치열하게 전쟁을 펼칩니다. 자원의 효율적인 사용과 현명한 지형 변형을 통해 패권을 장악하고 정착민들을 승리로 이끌어 보세요. Helge Ostertag와 Jens Drögemüller가 만들어낸 수많은 수상 경력의 보드 게임 Terra Mystica, 그 오리지널 디지털 버전을 만나 보세요. 전 세계 플레이어들과의 온라인 대전을 지원하며 AI를 상대로 실력을 시험해 볼 수도 있습니다.

Sometimes: Success Requires Sacrifice, the title says it all! You get thrown into a dark room, with no light to be found anywhere! Are you willing to end your life to light the way for the next generation to proceed further? Play it today and find out!
N++는 빠르게 진행되는 관성 기반의 플랫포머 게임입니다. 미니멀하고 멋지게 표현된 공간 안에서 장애물을 빠르게 뛰어넘고, 아슬아슬하게 적을 지나치고 금을 수집하세요.

Congratulations! You’ve been accepted as the only human student at the prestigious St. PigeoNation’s Institute, a school for talented birds! Roam the halls and find love in between classes as a sophomore student at the world’s greatest pigeon high school.
The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.
“알렉스가 깨어난 곳은 할머니의 집. 자신만 남겨둔 채 모두 사라져 버린 것을 발견한 알렉스는 이곳을 떠나려 하지만, 누군가... 아니 무엇인가 자신을 지켜보고 있는 꺼림칙한 기분이 든다. 정체를 알 수 없는 존재를 피해 밤을 무사히 넘기고 집에서 빠져나오지 못한다면, 미치는 것보다도 더욱 끔찍한 일이 일어날지 모른다.”

Battlevoid: Harbinger is a hard sci-fi space exploration game blending roguelike, turn-based, star map strategy, and real-time space battles. You are a young commander venturing out into enemy territories, to unknown galaxies, never knowing what you will face as you jump out from hyperspace.

Pinball HD Collection - This game will change your idea of Pinball. Each table - Wild West, The Deep, Jungle Style, Pirates, Red Planet, Snow, Da Vinci, Arcade, Tanks, Halloween and others - are masterpieces. You'll be stunned with the level of realism.
In this 2-player twin-stick shooter, use a friendly drone for a game-changing abilities. Survive waves, upgrade, and uncover the mystery in this cooperative, action-packed experience.
A hospitalized Boy comes to terms with his own story by traveling with his Mom to a beautiful fantasy world; ultimately helping his fellow patients find closure by walking a mile in their shoes.
삼은 “꿈의 성취” 라고 불리는 기관을 사퇴한 마약 중독자로 자신의 마약 문제에서 벗어나서 비참한 삶으로부터 헤어나려고 합니다. 하지만 그는 첫날밤부터 뭔가 잘못되어서 끝이 없는 악몽에 시달리게 됩니다…
Passing Pineview Forest is a free mini-prequel set in the universe of Pineview Drive. Behind the abandoned house on Pineview Drive lies ominous Pineview Forest...

An alien menace has descended on Earth! Defend the world from UFO invasion in this superb arcade shooter from Qute. Use your weapons effectively, deflect enemy bullets with your shield, and recapture the Moon from alien infestation!
It is a short but very interesting horror,about a man who woke up in his own grave,next to his family.

The servants of Lucifer stole the Stone of the Dead and opened the gates of the Hell! You are to fight with Lucifer and restore the Stone of the Dead before rising of the bloody moon! Otherwise, Lucifer will gain power over the world and the dark forces will remain forever in the world of the living.
온갖 수수께끼로 여러분의 뇌를 시험하면서 버튼을 누르는 비선형 퍼즐 게임
SBBP is a 2D platformer with pixel graphics. Blue boy’s girlfriend is kidnapped by aliens so he goes through 21 levels to save her and he also fight bosses along the way.
클래식 Gauntlet의 4인 협동 액션 게임플레이가 완전히 새로운 경험으로 돌아왔습니다! 로컬이나 온라인 co-op 멀티플레이어에서, 친구들과 함께 끝 없는 적 무리를 상대로 전투를 펼치고 보물과 영광을 차지하세요. 어둠 속으로 쳐들어가세요!
Originally released in 1998 on PC, and awarded as the Adventure Game of the Year, The timeless horror point-and-click, Sanitarium, is returning to frighten the bravest adventure game fans.

Tilt Brush lets you paint in 3D space with virtual reality. Unleash your creativity with three-dimensional brush strokes, stars, light, and even fire. Your room is your canvas. Your palette is your imagination. The possibilities are endless.

A story about an ordinary human girl and her romantic encounters with knights and princes. These characters may be gentle, passionate, considerate, or inhospitable. There are many character styles to suit a variety of individual player tastes.

A ridiculous live-action B-movie adventure you will never forget! You wake up to find your town in chaos. Everyone has gone crazy and is just attacking each other! A cryptic message is the secret to survival-- Press X to not die!
Kings of Israel is a strategic, turn based game based off the board game of the same name. Kings of Israel is easy to pick up but adapts in difficulty to challenge even the most advanced gamer.
You Have 10 Seconds 2 is the sequel to the popular Free to Play game "You Have 10 Seconds". You have 10 seconds to get from the start of each level to the end before time runs out and without dying.
Minimal physical puzzle with explosions
PegLotto!는 슬롯, 파칭코, 덱 빌딩을 결합한 로그라이크입니다. 아이템을 골라 배치한 뒤, 슬롯과 파칭코가 잘 되길 기도하세요! 차창 밖 풍경을 바라보며 편안하게 행운의 파도에 몸을 맡겨 보세요!

Experience cinematic kung-fu battles in the fastest, most intense brawler the indie world has ever seen! With the unique 1:1 response system of One Finger Death Punch, players will feel the immediate feedback of every bone-crunching hit. Pay tribute to the masters using five classic kung-fu styles mixed with additional weapons.

ko: 길드 오브 던저니어링 얼티밋 에디션 Guild of Dungeoneering Ultimate Edition
desc: 완전히 새로 재정비하고 리마스터된 길드 오브 던저니어링 얼티밋 에디션은 턴 기반의 던전 크롤러 게임이지만 다른 게임과는 약간 다릅니다. 영웅을 조종하는 대신 영웅을 둘러싼 던전을 건설하죠.

Cryptark is a 2D sci-fi shooter where you take on the role of a heavily armed privateer seeking to earn government contracts by boarding deadly alien space-hulks. It's up to you to strategize a plan of attack, pick an equipment loadout, and destroy the central core to be victorious.
Koala Kids is a puzzle-platformer game, in the style of retro games like Lode Runner. Includes Hot-seat Coop and Level Editor.

"The Deer" is an educational inter­ac­tive expe­ri­ence for children. You'll be an ancient Deer during the Pleistocene (Ice Age) epoch and you'll discover everything about this marvelous era. Unfortunately there were no T-Rex during this age since they were already extinct millions of years before.
Relive iconic battles of the American Civil War. Take command of both the Union and Confederate forces in this exciting turn-based strategy game.

Crashday, the explosive cult classic multiplayer racer, is back! Retooled and remastered, Crashday: Redline Edition brings back the fun and memories of the original with this lovingly crafted tribute edition, featuring all-new and expanded features, including Steam Workshop support. Today is Crashday!

Trick & Treat is a Visual Novel that test your instincts by making choices that can get you out from the cursed forest or drive you to death… or maybe just maybe your choices can guide you to something more?
Experience the full evolution of the award-winning Geometry Wars franchise and battle through waves of enemies on 3D grids in this frenetic arcade shooter!

Take command of humanity’s last survivors and rebuild an empire in the stars. In this immersive turn-based strategy game, you will have to fight to protect your people, control rival factions, and unlock lost technology.

ONE MORE LINE is a highly addictive, one button, space disco, skill timing game! Steam edition features 2-4 player local multi-player and no advertising. All for a very low price! Can you put a price on fun though?

Vietnam, 1965. You are Dean Shepard, a "cherry" to the 'Nam with zero war experience other than standard boot camp training at Parris Island, SC. Along with your platoon, you will fight the NVA and the Vietcong in true historic locales and battles.

Mindball Play is a physics based racing game. Roll over the competition in multiplayer or have fun in single player with time trials and campaign chapters. Explore up to 13 tracks and race your way through them with either a keyboard, mouse, gamepad or Tobii Eye Tracker.

Hyper color ball is a casual, difficult game. The game-play mechanics are based on testing your focus and dexterity skills. With a fast paced, upbeat soundtrack and a strong vibrant colours. Hyper color ball makes for a fantastic party game.
PhysDrive is a great physic simulated racing game with a giant map! Go through a big loops, falling blocks, destructible walls, fans, rails, stairs, spikes, traps and more!

DISTRUST is an isometric survival adventure with procedural generation on an Arctic research station lost in the endless dark of a polar night. A story-rich fiction with multiple endings that suits both singleplayer fans and co-op enthusiasts.
살아 움직이는 만화처럼 펼쳐지는 명작 플랫폼 어드벤처로 뛰어드세요. 꿈의 글레이드를 배경으로 한 60개 이상의 레벨을 혼자 또는 최대 3명의 친구와 함께 로컬 협동 플레이로 누비며 펀치하고, 활공하고, 탐험하세요.
곳곳에 도사리고 있는 위험과 수수께끼, 비밀 등으로 가득 찬 미지의 바다에 있는 섬들을 탐험하세요. 괴물과 싸우고 마법을 배우며 당신의 모험을 도와 줄 고대 보물들을 찾아내세요. 모든 기지와 기술을 발휘하여 고대왕국 아카디아와 바다괴물 Oceanhorn 의 미스테리를 풀어 보세요.
The Swindle is a steampunk cybercrime caper about breaking into buildings, hacking their systems, stealing all their cash, and quickly running away again before the police show up.

We Are The Dwarves is a real-time tactical adventure where you take control of three Dwarven astronauts and lead them through the hordes of enemies in the depths of their Universe. Tactical Adventure Sci-Fi Space Dwarves
선상의 모든 외계인을 몰살하는 서바이벌 모드 챌린지를 위해선 방아쇠를 끊임 없이 당길 수 있는 손가락과 고도의 전술이 필요합니다.

A narcotics police officer invades a logistics company, suspected of drug trafficking. Looking for evidence, he discovers an even greater secret, and his mission now and leave the place alive. iREC presents moments of tension, with an incredible atmosphere of terror.
Aces High III offers world class modeling of World War II planes, vehicles, and boats in a combat setting with hundreds of other players pitting their skills in any given online arena.

Rebuild a ruined city in this post-apocalyptic mix of strategy and simulation. Manage survivors, scavenge for food and supplies, deal with rival gangs, illness, interpersonal strife and zombie attacks.

A Tactical Battle Simulator that allows you to command thousands of soldiers as a Union or Confederate General. The game features the most accurately created map, a non-linear battle campaign, complex morale, innovative control mechanics and smart AI.
In this tug-of-war, casual defense game， you play Leonidas who is the hero-king of Sparta, against hordes of attacking zombies in Thermopylae. Recruit allies and build defenses to stop them!
Explore a vast universe with pulse-pounding action, side-splitting humor, and hair-raising plot twists in these 2 classic space adventure games.
Gridworld is an artificial life and evolution simulator. Watch creatures evolve through natural selection as they learn to find food, avoid danger, and compete with other creatures for survival.

Fight against the robots and reclaim the land! Attempt to survive in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, where it seems like everything wants you dead! Tactical stealth action in a post-apocalyptic settings!
12 orbits는 이용 기기에 상관없이 한 번에 2명에서 12명의 사람들이 함께 플레이할 수 있는 유일한 로컬 멀티플레이어 게임입니다. 키보드, 터치스크린, 컨트롤러 중 하나만 있으면 됩니다.
Heartbound is a non-traditional role-playing game about a boy, his dog, secrets, and sanity.

In this turn-based strategic artillery game, players wage interplanetary wars by developing their home planets and firing massive barrages through the unpredictable gravity fields of the solar system.

위협을 받고 있는 세계의 유일한 희망이 빛나는 갑옷에 있는 것이 아니라 부적응자와 범죄자 무리의 손아귀에 있다면 어떤 일이 벌어질까요? 새로운 회전 기반 전략 RPG인 블랙가드가 바로 이 질문을 탐구합니다. 범죄, 마약 및 살인의 어둡고도 성숙한 이야기 속에서 180개 이상의 고유한 마법 기반의 전장을 발견하게 될 것입니다.전사, 마법사 또는 사냥꾼으로 활동하면서 자신의 캐릭터 기술을 적합하다고 생각하는 것으로 마음껏 설정하십시오. 도전적인 캠페인은 의심, 반역죄 및 손실의 이야기를 전달합니다. 주요 전환점에서 이야기의 과정을 결정하고 그 결과를 알아냅니다.

Kivi, Toilet and Shotgun is a single player top down action game where your goal is to reach the end of the desert by avoiding all kinds of obstacles and fighting the desert raiders. Go up against foes in your vehicle and on foot. Take on powerful bosses, but make sure you're quipped for the fight!

In Bus Driver, your job is to transport passengers around an attractive and realistic city. You must drive to a timetable on a planned route, whilst obeying traffic rules, and taking care not to upset or injure your passengers.
700 만 가지가 넘는 모바일 다운로드가 포함 된 스릴 넘치는 포인트 앤 클릭 모험 인 The Silent Age에서 완전히 쇄신되어 PC 용으로 업데이트되었습니다.
Set sail for 17th-century British Colonial Mars in Jamestown+: a cooperative shoot-em-up for 1-4 brave souls, designed to be exciting for players of all skill levels.
데스크톱에서 펼쳐지는 강렬한 방치형 RPG! 'Desktop Wallet Heroes'는 작업 방해 없이 화면 하단에서 캐릭터가 끊임없이 몬스터를 사냥하는 오버레이 RPG입니다. 아이템을 강화하고 전리품을 모아 스팀 커뮤니티 마켓에서 거래하세요!
Wartile is a cool-down based strategy game in which you control a warband of Viking figurines in a miniature universe inspired by Norse mythology. Unravel its secrets and rein the powers of the gods.
Assemble patchwork mosaics, meet your favorite heroes from the world beyond the looking glass and help Alice become the queen!
Create and control the business empire of your dreams. This in-depth strategy game covers almost every aspect of business that could be encountered in the real world.

Become an appraised bridge engineer and architect in Bridge Constructor. Create and design your own constructions and watch the cars and trucks pass over them - or see them fall and crash while your inferior creations collapse due to weight and the laws of physics!

A speeding power boat, a humble tug to a luxury cruise liner. Captain eight highly detailed ships, fight against realistic water physics and take in spectacular vistas as you navigate famous European ports.
새로운 액션이 넘치는 오픈 월드를 기대하세요. 거대한 세계를 탐험하며 장비 및 방어시설을 위한 재료를 수집하세요. 원하는 대로 모든 것을 사용해서 기지를 방어하고 몬스터 적들을 정복하세요. 1인에서 8인까지 온라인에서 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다!

1979 Revolution: Black Friday is a choice driven, narrative game that brings players into the brooding world of a nation on the verge of collapse. Play as Reza, an aspiring photojournalist, and make life and death decisions as you survive the gritty streets of Iran in the late 1970’s.

Conquest of Elysium 4 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.
Crown and Council is a casual strategy game with short game sessions.

In Heroes of Dire, a new massively-multiplayer tactical role-playing game by Spellbook, players command squads of fighters through strategic turn-based battles to win treasure, fame, and glory for their guilds!

en: GO AWAY, THERE'S KUMIS OVER THERE!
ko: GO AWAY, THERE'S KUMIS OVER THERE!
desc: This arcade runner is about a horse and our favorite drink - kumis! Collect cookies, pick up items like multipliers, bombs, HPs and try to get as high score as you can. Cookies are your best friends in that game!
Blazing Chrome의 세계에서는 기계가 온 세계를 지배하고, 인류는 극소수만 남아 멸망 직전으로 내몰렸습니다. 인간은 모든 힘과 명예, 지위를 잃고 금속과 회로로 이루어진 군주들이게 무릎을 꿇었습니다.

After a decade, a Might & Magic® RPG is back with both the unique core formula and a new set of improved and fine-tuned features. The best RPG of its class!In the wake of the spectacular events in Might & Magic® Heroes® VI, you will play in a party of four adventurers entangled in intrigue and political machinations unfolding in...

Enter a dark, captivating world as the massive evil of Black Mirror Castle is reincarnated with over 100 atmospheric locations to explore and 40 different characters to interact with. Will Darren's search lead him to redemption or the hell of insanity?

Urban Empire is a ‘City Ruler’, pioneering a new breed of strategy game that combines city builder features with political scheming and adds profound social and historical events into the mix, creating a whole new gameplay experience.

Yargis is a fast paced, top down spaceship shooter. Customize your ship to join a battle online or offline. Yargis is focused on team based, close combat action. The game has a variety of battle and co-op game modes and a powerful editor make Yargis a great game!
20주년을 맞는 「바이오하자드」 개발팀의 도전이자 슈터 게임 팬들에게 제안되는 컨페터피브(경기용) 슈터에 참전하자! 바이오하자드 세계 특유의 요소를 곳곳에 넣고, 스토리 요소를 제외하고 전략과 기술을 다하여 겨루는 심플한 게임성을 철처히 추구한 작품
A fast paced multiplayer FPS game that focuses on creative weapons and game mechanics that reward skillful killing!
Pixel Puzzles 2: RADical ROACH는 RADical 스타일의 전통적인 스타일의 직소 퍼즐 게임입니다.
Counter Agents is a spy-themed, head-to-head multiplayer game where your objective is to sneak around guards, steal the briefcase, and make it to an exit point before your opponent!

Welcome to the IKEA Virtual Reality kitchen experience, where you can make some virtual pancakes. Our IKEA kitchen specialist will guide you through some of the key aspects of a well-planned kitchen. And look out for the instructions that will help you to prepare those perfect pancakes.

en: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky SC
ko: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky SC
desc: Picking up shortly after The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky, Estelle travels across Liberl in search of Joshua. The journey involves more than seeking loved ones, however, as the Bracer Guild also tasks her with unraveling the mysteries behind the newly unveiled Society of Ouroboros.

Close Combat: Gateway to Caen is a great release in the critically-acclaimed Close Combat series. Gateway to Caen focuses on the largest, concentrated British offensive since the Normandy landings in an attempt to penetrate the German lines west of Caen and cross the Odon River to get the stalled advance moving again.
디마이스 오브 네이션즈 는 로마의 흥망성쇠와 현대문명을 무대로한 4X 턴 기반 대전략 게임입니다.
Escape is a simple 2D game with 35 levels already unlocked (for the sake of gaming of course). Require jumping skills, a brain and patience. Enjoy :)
스구리의 가속 2는 빛과 같은 속도로 진행되는 오렌지 주스 사의 대전형 슈팅 게임으로, 스구리 세계관의 모든 인기 캐릭터들이 등장합니다.
Neon Hardcorps is a fast paced top down action shooter, inspired by games such as Contra, Metal Slug, Super Turrican, Cybernator, Realm and Doom Troopers.
요리, 서빙 그리고 당신의 레스토랑 경영 전 세계 요리: 패스트푸드, 케밥, 중화요리, 초밥 & 피자 당신의 실력을 보여주고 배고픈 손님들에게 음식을 주세요!

Become the leader of any contemporary country in this streamlined real-time grand strategy game. Use diplomacy, espionage, military and economic power to deal with other nations, while tackling issues such as terrorism, financial crises and medical epidemics, all in an effort to achieve global domination!
Darkwater는 1-4인용 협동 탈출 호러 게임입니다. 직접 만든 잠수함을 타고 외계 행성의 얼어붙을 듯한 깊은 바다에서 살아남으세요. 적함 및 깊은 바닷속 괴물과 싸우고 자원을 모으세요. 살아남기 위해 최선을 다하세요.

Pinball Arcade by FarSight Studios features exact recreations of the all-time greatest pinball tables from Stern Pinball® and Gottlieb® together in one game. Every flipper, bumper, sound effect, and display pixel has been painstakingly emulated in astonishing detail.

Marauder, is a squad based and tactical 3D game with RPG elements. It was released in late 2009, in Russia. You may know these names as the former made Brigade 7,62 and the later also published Pathologic.

Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds! Enjoy fast and frantic arcade-style beat 'em up gameplay with cute characters. Beat up hordes of weird enemies with awesome special attacks. Local co-op and PVP supported for up to 4 players!

Painters Guild is a management sim where you control an art academy in the Italian Renaissance. Paint artwork as beautiful as the Mona Lisa. Hire painters like Leonardo da Vinci and millions of randomly generated ones. Expand and customize your guild with furniture and more.

In DoD you take the role of a driver passionate about drifting, driving your car around the world on all kinds of environments and weather conditions, while taking on different challenges and avoiding all kinds of obstacles and hazards.

Hello Comrades ! You think you got what it takes to be tru slav? Then we have game for you ! Prove to all your gopnik friends that you are the superior alpha slav your babushka always wanted you to be.
Machine Hunt is a first person, fast paced, chaotic shooting game that pits heavily armed players against machines that have only one goal, destroy humanity.

SteamWorld Dig is an action-adventure puzzler with strong Metroidvanian influences set in the SteamWorld Universe. You’ll need to dig deep into the earth, gather resources to upgrade your tools and abilities, take on enemies, solve challenging puzzles and uncover the secrets to save a dying town.

Ascension to the Throne is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements. In a vast fantasy world the hero will have to pass many tests on his way to victory. Enemies seek to stop players from regaining power and taking revenge. Gain new friends to aid you in reclaiming the throne.
레오스 포춘은 당신의 골드를 훔쳐간 비열하고 신비로운 도둑을 뒤쫓는 플랫폼 어드벤처 게임입니다. 수작업으로 아름답게 만들어진 레벨을 통해서 이 장대한 모험을 즐기는 레오의 이야기에 빠져드십시오.

More 16-bit RPG goodness from Warfare Studios with this dark and thrilling adventure. Can you solve the mystery of the Monastery? Brave the unknown terrors inside, find hidden rooms and secret chambers, and unlock the mysterious past before the sun comes up, and you may get out alive!

Space Food Truck is a cooperative, culinary scifi adventure. 1-4 players take on unique roles aboard the Galaxy Gourmet. Their mission: explore a vast, procedurally-generated galaxy in search of exotic ingredients, craft delicious recipes, and withstand the untold dangers of deep space.
A machine ponders its loneliness. It scans the radio spectrum for an answer to its question.

Dark Ages is a tactical digital board game set in the violent world of alternate Middle Ages. Vikings against war elephants, musketeers against the Mongol cavalry, ancient phalanx legions against crusaders; the deadliest armies in history clashing in bloody war.
Slash It is a 2D colorful arcade game. The goal is to match shapes, press letters and numbers in the right time and direction.

planetarian HD is an engaging and emotional visual novel from legendary game studio, Key. A sub-brand of VISUAL ARTS, Key are also famed for creating Kanon, AIR, CLANNAD, Little Busters!, Rewrite, Angel Beats!, and Summer Pockets.
Divine Divinity is an epic role-playing game with hack-and-slash action, offering a huge world to explore and thousands of items to investigate, trade and use.

Lords of Xulima is a challenging Role-playing game set on the mythical continent of Xulima, where Gods and humans once walked side by side. Experience a genuine RPG featuring over 100 hours of gameplay, and discover one of the most epic sagas ever told.

Get ready for ridiculous fun in this multiplayer free-roaming stunting game. Drive a bus, tank or monster truck and speed across huge open worlds. Level up your car, participate in random events and discover secret areas. Buy now and get a free copy to gift to your friend!
Your way to freedom only involves your intelligence and the puzzles!

en: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature (Platinum Edition)
ko: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature (Platinum Edition)
desc: The legendary hero Hercules and his wife Megara are back, ready to embark on their next adventure! The Gods are outraged at their defeat and have summoned a fearsome beast who can match Hercules's god-like strength.

Medusa’s Labyrinth is a very short mythological first-person horror game set in ancient Greece. It takes myths and legends that have stayed with us for over 2000 years and mix them together with modern gameplay. The game let's you explore murky catacombs and follow along a classic, tragic story.

en: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!
ko: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!
desc: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove! is a mash-up of the very best features of the classic console games with a ton of fresh improvements! Explore Earth as funky aliens from planet Funkotron trying to find your missing ship pieces to get back home in this casual co-op roguelike.
Motocross 챔피언십의 유일한 공식 비디오 게임으로 오토바이 레이스의 짜릿함을 느껴 보세요!

Lode Runner Legacy is the latest edition in the popular Lode Runner series. Players control “Runner” to recover stolen gold while avoiding enemies and minefields. Enjoy the ingenious balance of puzzle and action gameplay, an updated Voxel visual style and powerful game editors. Ver.2.0 Update is out now!
Door Kickers is an innovative realtime strategy game that puts you in charge of a SWAT team and lets you command them during a tactical intervention.

en: Broken Sword 4 - the Angel of Death (2006)
ko: Broken Sword 4 - the Angel of Death (2006)
desc: When a mysterious and beautiful woman rushes into George Stobbart’s office, pleading for help, he cannot know that he will be inextricably drawn into terrifying conspiracy, and a desperate search for a nefarious artifact of great and terrible power. For George, it looks like the world needs saving. Again.

Victor Frankenstein, an old friend and a brilliant scientist has managed to resurrect the dead! However the border between life and death is fragile and Victor has learned the hard way that this balance should not be tempered with...
Pixel Puzzles Mosaics is a nontraditional puzzle game.

Clash is a hard-core action/rpg arena blend. With a wide variety of skills to mix and match that inspires creativity and unique styles, Clash lives up to its goal as an action game for the brainy. Play multiplayer with friends or compete in the single-player league by making your way up the leader-board.
내 파일 속에 살아 있는 슈팅·보석 수집 게임. Corridors는 최고 점수를 노리는 액션에 완전한 기능의 직관적인 파일·미디어 탐색기를 결합했습니다. 미리 준비된 월드에서 경쟁하거나, 내 PC와 파일을 무대로 삼으세요. 가볍고 포터블하며 대부분의 시스템에서 네이티브로 실행됩니다.
A turn-based, party-based RPG set in the Age of Decadence world and focused on squad level tactical combat. Fight your way out of prison mine or die trying.

DED - a game in the shoot'em up genre. Your granddaughter has been kidnapped, and your daughter and son-in-law murdered. Having just bits and pieces of information about the abductors, you will have to save your granddaughter and find the masterminds behind these crimes.
Paradox Soul is a chilling fight for exploration and survival; a Metroidvania pixel action-shooter hybrid!
불 속으로 장난감을 던져 넣고 신나게 불태우며, 주요 스토리가 따뜻한 벽난로 앞에서 펼쳐지는 독특한 구성의 모험을 떠나세요. 과연 여러분은 굴뚝 위로 펼쳐진 싸늘한 하늘과 꽁꽁 얼어버린 바깥세상의 의문을 풀어낼 수 있을까요? 월드 오브 구, 휴먼 리소스 머신 및 70억 명의 인간들을 탄생시킨 개발진이 창조한 기묘한 세상을 만나 보세요!
A strange and twisted world...Harvester! The most violent adventure game of all time comes to Steam!

日本語バージョンダウンロード開始されました。Two girls, blessed with magical powers, are faced with the task of saving the lonely protagonist from the clutches of a mysterious witch and ancient evil, sealed away long ago by his ancestors. What does this sorceress want from our protagonist?

“TWINKLE STAR SPRITES ”, a competitive 2D top-down view scrolling shooter released on NEOGEO MVS in 1996, departs for new adventures on the Steam gaming platform!Master your shots, and aim for the magical Twinkle Star”!

Corgi Warlock is a 1-4 player side-scrolling fantasy action game, where one brave Corgi will take on the Skeleton Bunny King's army! Against the power of Narwhals, Fencing Bears, and Crazed Unicorns, it takes more than your average Corgi to survive the King's onslaught... it takes a CORGI WARLOCK.
만약 이 세계에 인간처럼 말하고 웃고 울고 슬퍼할 수 있는 로봇이 존재한다면… 당신은 어떤 식으로 그 로봇을 대하시겠습니까?
Join Cubert on his journey to reach his true love in Box Maze, a platforming adventure filled with challenging levels, dangerous enemies, hidden secrets, and powerful bosses.
MechDefender는 두 게임 장르의 혁신적인 융합으로, 탑다운 슈팅 게임의 강렬한 액션과 타워 디펜스의 전략적 깊이를 완벽하게 혼합합니다.
사이카델릭한 미로를 탐색하며 시원한 일렉트로닉 비트를 즐겨보세요. 슈퍼 미트 보이와 지오메트리 워즈가 섞여 있다고 상상해 보세요.
Dragons: they have been hunted, they have been slain, but now the hour to strike back has come.

en: Hegemony III: Clash of the Ancients
ko: Hegemony III: Clash of the Ancients
desc: Command armies, manage resources, and build an empire in this real-time strategy wargame from Longbow Games. Will Rome fulfil its destiny to rule the ancient world or will history be rewritten to forge a new Etruscan, Gallic, or Greek hegemony!
Over 35 levels of challenging gameplay -- Race at the speed of light, fight off computer Viruses and engage in violent digital combat.

en: The Thrill of the Fight 2 Spectator
ko: The Thrill of the Fight 2 Spectator
desc: Gather your friends to watch your matches with a "live sports" style camera on a connected PC for your matches in The Thrill of The Fight 2 currently available on Meta Quest.

고전 횡스크롤식 디자인과 최첨단 게임플레이의 만남, ChAIR 의 틀을 깨는 창의력이 집대성된 Shadow Complex 강화판에는, 향상된 그래픽의 원작 게임 콘텐츠 전체뿐 아니라, 역동적인 근접 테이크 다운 기술, 업적, 마스터 챌린지도 추가되어 있습니다. 10 시간 이상의 탐험과 빠른 호흡으로 전개되는 전투를 통해, 플레이어는 게임의 판도가 바뀌는 강력한 파워 업을 발견하고 장애물을 넘어 수많은 적들을 물리치며, 역동적으로 펼쳐지는 신비롭고 험난한 게임 월드에 몰입하게 됩니다.

Take control over seven of the biggest industrial machines in the world. During the 14 mission campaign you will punch through the snows of Greenland, plow the steppes of Wyoming and travel all the way to sunny Florida. Your hard work will be completed by launching a space shuttle into space.
State of Mind는 미래 세계에서 트랜스휴머니즘 사상을 깊이 파고드는 스릴러 게임입니다. 이 게임은 물적 현실의 디스토피아와 가상의 유토피아로 갈라진 미래 세계에서 이별과 분리, 재통합이라는 주제를 다룹니다.
Rewind time and manipulate gravity in order to solve parkour puzzles in this exciting new 2D platformer.
Kevin is fed up with his game. Follow him in this atmospheric, dark and funny journey and fulfil his dreams. Is it even possible to escape?
Severance는 1~5인 온라인 협동 공포 게임입니다. 한 명은 유령이 되고 나머지는 조사자가 됩니다. 친구를 괴롭히고, 물건을 던지고, 문을 쾅 닫아 이성을 깎아내리거나, 팀워크로 진실을 밝혀내라.

Planet Alcatraz is a 3D role playing game with isometric projection. The player travels through the game world and fights against enemies in the real-time mode.Several genres are mixed in this game but despite that fact it isn't stuck between them and appears to be a classical RPG that is based on a specially developed system.

Basement is a strategy game, where you start doing illegal business to fund the development of your dream video game. It won't be easy, so get ready to deal with other gangs, cops, crazy junkies, mysterious investor and even ghosts from the past.

The world is shattering and you are the only hope to restore the balance. A thrilling and challenging 3D puzzle platformer game, Almightree: The Last Dreamer has you racing through a crumbling world to find your way to awaken the life giving Almightree.
A hybrid of adventure game and classic grid-based dungeon crawler, set in the medieval Czech town of Jilemnice and its hilly surroundings.

„The Lion's Song: Episode 1 – Silence" draws the player into the life of a talented young composer, Wilma, preparing for her breakthrough concert, the defining moment of her career. Searching for inspiration she escapes from the pressure for success to the solitude of the Austrian Alps.
Defend your ancestral castle – show the invader who the master is! Build towers, save money, train your spells, and your enemy will be vanquished.
숲에서 이상한 것이 나타난다. 어둡고 미지의 장소에서 길을 잃은 채, 무자비한 적을 피해 살아남고 퍼즐을 풀며 이 땅을 뒤덮은 고대의 비밀을 밝혀내는 러브크래프트식 코스믹 호러 어드벤처.

Across all dimensions, the only constant is Darkness! A procedurally generated RPG-roguelike journey across the multiverse! In One Way Heroics, you take on the role of an intrepid adventurer who must travel across the land and face the Demon Lord before a mysterious darkness engulfs everything.
Warrior Kings: Battles maintains the excitement that made Warrior Kings a leading RTS. It is a stand-alone title that adds a new strategic and tactical dimension to the series.

Uncompromising Sci-Fi survival on Mars! Manage the entire colony single-handed! Craft, Research, Explore and Fight against evolving mutants. Vast open world and randomly generated levels to explore! Can you survive long enough to escape the horror?

en: Runika: A World of Little Legends
ko: Runika: A World of Little Legends
desc: Build a farm… to save the world. Runika combines a cozy 2D sandbox with a story about a world being drawn into the mysterious Rift. Grow crops at your own pace, build your farm, gather resources, craft your own equipment, and uncover what awakens within the Rift.

Travel back in time and witness the horrors of slave trade firsthand. You will be working as young slave steward on a ship crossing the Atlantic. You are to serve the captain and be his eyes and ears. What do you do, when you realize that your own sister has been captured by the slave traders?
Put your flatulent skills to the test in this fast-paced toot-shooting gas-passing masterpiece.
Your goal is to destroy all buildings on the mission and defeat all Bosses. One combat operation includes 5 levels and 1 boss mission.
많은 사랑을 받은 디즈니 캐릭터가 등장하는The Disney Afternoon Collection은 게이밍의 황금기와 모험으로 가득한 오후로 여러분을 데려갑니다. 6가지 고전 게임은 전부 새롭게 개선된 그래픽을 제공하며 레트로의 모습과 느낌을 재현할 수 있는 필터링 옵션도 있습니다.

Join the adventures of Little Jack. You will need to solve many interconnected puzzles that involve finding keys, pushing crates in order to reach the exit door. The game will have 4 difficulty levels so that each person regardless of its skill level can enjoy this game.
Ride your music in more ways than ever before. Audiosurf 2 is the music game for your entire music collection. Hundreds of mods/skins on Workshop. Free demo available.

IT’S HERE, FATE FANS! FATE - The Traitor Soul has arrived on Steam! This third game has more loot, more spells, more heroes and, most importantly, more pets. Hit “add to cart” already! Or read on for more details on this classic game.

en: Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS
ko: Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS
desc: This is an isolated town, a town of memories that have been forgotten by its people. However, this small town has not been quiet and peaceful since the murders began... Time passes by, where are the sinful spirits going? Are my memories reality, or just a dream?

Zombie Party is a retro rampage of fun and over-the-top action, while still giving the players a deep and engaging Action-RPG Rogue-like experience! Go on a time traveling adventure, or delve deep into procedural dungeons full of gold, loot, and secrets!

A few heroes are facing hundreds of foes – are you even able to lead the coolest fantasy people to victory against the dark hordes? Explore a vast world, fight tactical real-time battles, and experience the fantastic story based on the bestseller "The Dwarves".
Massively multiplayer online game in the world of magic and steam. Become a pirate or a trader, a carrier or a manufacturer in this unfriendly world inhabited by dragons.

en: HEBEREKE!: March! Red Army Girls' Brigade
ko: HEBEREKE!: March! Red Army Girls' Brigade
desc: 1939년 9월. 인류 역사상 최대의 전쟁 ‘제2차 세계 대전’의 막이 올랐다. 당신은 소비에트군 독립 소녀 여단의 여단장으로 취임해, 5년에 걸친 전쟁을 진두지휘하게 된다. 생명의 물 보드카를 양식 삼아, 미소녀 사령관들과 함께 소비에트 인민에게 승리를 가져다주는 것이다, 우라!!!
Bend and twist reality in A Fisherman's Tale, the mind-bending VR puzzle adventure game in which being turned upside down and inside out is not merely a play on words.
○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

"Desperados: Wanted Dead or Alive" is the first strategy game ever to combine a movie-based and story-driven atmosphere of an adventure game with the intellectual challenge of a real time tactic game.In this western-style title, discover a game of strategy and tactics played out in exceptional real time.

Perfect Golf is a next generation, indie developed, single player and multiplayer golf game. Perfect Golf provides a truly immersive experience centered on stunning visuals and hyper-realistic game play. Don't just play golf - play PerfectGolf!
An ex-minister ventures through the frozen depths of Hell in search of his kidnapped daughter.

Pixel Dungeon is an exciting and extremely popular roguelike (more than 2 million mobile installs!). Explore the depths of Pixel Dungeon, collect useful items and fight fierce monsters to find the Amulet of Yendor - the ultimate artefact of this game world!

en: Red Comrades Save the Galaxy: Reloaded
ko: Red Comrades Save the Galaxy: Reloaded
desc: Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev and his fellow aide Petka realize that someone has stolen the Red banner from the HQ. Although it's not the end of the story yet! Somewhere on the moon, legions of alien invaders prepare to conquer Earth. But could such a little thing really give a scare to the Red Army heroes?

Niche - a genetics survival game is a turn-based strategy game combined with simulation and roguelike elements. Shape your own species of animals based on real genetics. Keep your species alive against all odds, such as predators, climate change and spreading sickness.
You are a chef in VR who need to satisfy your customers in a limited amount of time. Share the experience with a friend in local multiplayer mode. Chaotic levels are waiting for you!
Deus Ex: Breach is an innovative game that offers, for the very first time, an arcade approach on the gameplay of Deus Ex.
A highly moddable destructible physics sandbox. Built for VR and non-VR.
An UNCONVENTIONAL ADVENTURE RPG that takes place in an inexpressible world filled with amusing musical battles and strange delightful encounters. To put it simply: You are in for a ride.🍄
Warlock 2 is a turn-based strategy game of fantasy warfare. Rival against Great Mages, lead mighty armies into fierce battles, wield ancient magic and faith as your weapons.
Strategists to the frontline!The HD remake of the Nintendo DS classic.Are you the strategist that the world has been waiting for?

In a small village in central Europe something is happening, the forest growing around has something different. Its wood is red color, unique in the world. This does not pass unnoticed to the world's largest logging company, the White Wood Company
Vinyl is a dynamic indie music game created by graduate students at the University of Utah EAE program, that experiments with the aesthetic distance between gameplay and music.

'The Guest' is a gloomy adventure full of enigmas where the exploration of your surroundings comes to prominence; puzzles, secrets and riddles will help you discover who has locked you in this somber hotel room and most importantly, why.

8-Bit Armies is a retro Real-Time Strategy game. With a colorful, blocky voxel art style, 8-Bit Armies is Petroglyph's most fast-paced, friendly, and accessible RTS game to date. Featuring a campaign of 25 single-player missions, 12 co-op missions, multiplayer and skirmish modes.

Run a Thieves Guild in a gas-lit Victorian city! Antihero is a fast-paced digital board game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory.
Kombine is a minimalist puzzle game played on a grid. The goal is to remove all of the blocks that have borders by matching three or more of the same blocks together.

June 7th, 1995. 1:15 AM. You arrive home after a year abroad. You expect your family to greet you, but the house is empty. Something's not right. Where is everyone? And what's happened here? Unravel the mystery for yourself in Gone Home, a story exploration game from The Fullbright Company.
Tumblestone은 매치 3 장르를 완전히 새롭게 창조해심오하고 머리를 써야 하는 당신이 절대 잊을 수 없는 퍼즐 해결 경험을 제공합니다!

They came without warning, squawking menacingly, their ruffled feathers darkening the sun. Invading intergalactic chickens, out to punish humanity for our oppression of their earthly brethren. Now they're back, and they're having Earth for dinner!
자동차 스턴트 놀이터에서 뛰놀 준비 되셨나요? 크로스 플랫폼 멀티플레이어 게임에서 자유 주행을 하며 상상을 초월하는 재미를 느끼세요! 거대한 오픈 월드에서 몬스터 트럭, 탱크, 그 외에 수많은 멋진 차량을 몰아보세요. 레벨을 올리고, 이벤트에 참가하고, 캐시를 벌고, 새 차를 해제하고, 그리고 훨씬 더!
"Hanafuda" is a traditional Japanese card game. Now you can enjoy "Koi Koi," its most well-known variation, in a purely Japanese milieu with elegant and refined graphics. Online Multiplayer!!

en: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition
ko: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition
desc: In this tactical combat & dungeon crawler mash-up, explore a massive dungeon, full of danger, mystery and secrets. Fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful creatures, with your tank, healer & damage dealers party.

en: Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet The Medic
ko: Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet The Medic
desc: Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet the Medic – be the Medic and operate on the Heavy in this free and exclusive teaser for the HTC Vive!
시간 트랩에서 벗어나보세요!
Overcome obstacles and restore the cyber world ByteFamily, eliminating the system virus, unlocking new game modes and gaining new skills! HERE IS THE TERRIBLE WORLD ENEMIES BYTE FAMILY
에밋과 함께 반란군과 손을 잡고 로드 비지니스의 사악한 계획을 막는 영웅적인 모험을 떠나세요. 하지만 에밋은 황당하게도 하나도 준비가 안 되어 있군요. 배트맨, 슈퍼맨, 원더 우먼, 그린 닌자, 간달프, 셰익스피어, 클레오파트라, 그리고 많은 캐릭터들을 포함한 90명이 넘는 플레이 가능한 캐릭터들이 등장하는 놀라운 모험이 펼쳐집니다.

Experience a true classic! This Gold edition includes the original Jagged Alliance plus the add-on Jagged Alliance: Deadly Games. Take a trip into retro land and learn why this is considered to be one the best turn-based games of all times.

Want to survive? - Arm yourself and survive. Crafting, shooting, transport and much more awaits you in the Survival game. What happened to the world around and why he died - you may find out. But is this the main question now?
The Tape is a slow and creepy first person horror game, with mystical story and abstract psychological elements.

Prospekt begins in the Nova Prospekt prison in the Half-Life universe. Gordon Freeman is slowly being overrun by soldiers in the prison, however unknown to him, his Vortigaunt allies manage to find some help from a forgotten hero.
Hitman GO is a simple to play, but difficult to master turn-based strategy game set in a stunning interpretation of the Hitman universe.

Drayt Empire is a classic RPG. Ronarke and Drayt, best Friends on an adventure to seek out and find the lost forbidden City of Rahland. On their travels they will encounter many challenges which will test their friendship and strength.

Goat Duty is a multiplayer shooter where you get the chance to shatter other armed goats to pieces in madness and crazy matches. Throw other goats to the deep end, watch them fly, and test your skills while wearing the craziest skins in our four multiplayer modes. Are you ready? Set? GOOOOATS!
Doodle God은 헤어날 수 없는 퍼즐 및 세계 건설 게임으로 플레이어가 논리와 독창성을 사용해 우주 전체를 창조해요. 이 모든 연령이 즐길 수 있는 중독적인 퍼즐 게임에서, 불, 흙, 물 그리고 공기를 다양하게 섞고 결합해 우주를 창조하세요!

Mortal Online is a first-person medieval fantasy MMORPG, set in a huge, open, unforgiving world. Choose your race, choose your playstyle, choose a profession, choose where to place your loyalties - if you have any...

Life on Earth is unsustainable. Humanity must seek a new home but the only planet found is very hostile. You were sent on a expedition to slay the monsters inhabiting the surface of this planet. In this adventure you end up being the villain. Game contains two basic controls, many puzzles and lots of guns and enemies.
만약 네가 멋지지 않다고 생각하면, 숨어라. 메카니카가 멋지지 않은 너를 부숴버릴 것이다.

Once upon a time, a little boy from our world found himself in another, more mystical world where a magical crown made him ruler over a floundering kingdom called Alpoko. You are this little boy, and it's your duty to make Alpoko great...so you can then expand its dominion and take over the world!

Created by solo developer Nikola Kostic - Have you ever wanted to poop on people but were too shy to just go for it? There's poop in my soup lets you do just that, poop in soups, poop on people, poop on poodles, poop anywhere you please, from the streets of New York to Paris to Beijing.
당신 자신의 초자연적 과거를 직면하세요!
Every activity in Puzzle Pirates is a uniquely fun puzzle: be it sailing, gunning, or hauling treasure, your own puzzling skill determines your success!

A hand-drawn tribute to hilarious '90s adventure games (with none of the accompanying frustration). Play as Joey Claire, a puzzle-solving teen snatched out of her time (1994) and place (Earth) and stranded on a hostile alien planet on the brink of rebellion.

Castle Story is a creative voxel-based strategy game in which you can build castles one brick at a time using an army of little creatures called Bricktrons. Design and build your own castles, expand your territory in a vast landscape and defend your Bricktrons against onslaughts of hostile creatures.
Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'em up game mixed up with randomized dungeon crawling and exploration, which you can play alone or with a friend online.
Run, hit, switch, fall, love, plug, pull. And push.
Battle of the Bulge is a fast-paced WW2 game where precise movement and detailed planning make the difference between a vain attempt and a brave operation.

Redemption: Eternal Quest is a casual RPG/Sim game which combines the feel of an RPG with roster management sim mechanics. You become the leader of a band of adventurers, guiding them through quests, watching them grow and signing them to pacts while keeping your gold pouch filled.

en: OPUS: The Day We Found Earth
ko: OPUS: The Day We Found Earth
desc: OPUS: 우리가 지구를 발견한 날은 냉혹했습니다. OPUS는 이야기를 따라가는 방식의 게임을 즐기고 명왕성에 대해서 논쟁하는 사람들에게 환상적인 경험을 가져다 줍니다. 플레이어는 우주 망원경의 렌즈를 통하여 목적과 추구의 이야기를 읽어나갑니다.
Rogalia는 오픈월드, 식사 기반의 캐릭터 레벨링, 귀엽고 아늑한 분위기의 샌드박스 게임입니다.

You are Rick Guiver, a reckless coast guard rescue helicopter pilot. A terrible oilrig catastrophe has happened in the coast! Against your superiors' orders and better judgement you jump in your helicopter and fly to the danger zone! There's no time to lose, save as many people as you can!

Enter the magical world of Tangledeep, a beautifully polished dungeon crawler inspired by classic 16-bit RPGs! Colorful characters, a unique job system, tons of skills, items, and diverse environments with deep, turn-based roguelike gameplay. A different adventure every time you play!

DreadOut is a third person supernatural horror game where you play as Linda, a high school student trapped in an old abandoned town. Equipped with her trusty smart-phone, she will battle against terrifying encounters and solve mysterious puzzles which will ultimately determine her fate.

Prepare to inhabit a world of chivalry, class warfare and off-beat pop references. Knights of Pen & Paper 2 is a turn-based, retro style, pixel-art adventure full of danger, intrigue, death, and saving throws!

en: It came from space and ate our brains
ko: It came from space and ate our brains
desc: 친구 한 명, 많으면 세 명과 팀을 이루어 외계인을 우주로 날려버리면서 한도까지 점수를 올리세요. 그런 다음에는? 이 액션 만땅 아케이드 슈팅 게임에서 최고로 폼 나게 죽는 겁니다!

President for a Day- Corruption gives you the opportunity to assume the role of an African president. As such, you must make controversial decisions revolving around topics such as: democratic evolution, corruption, development aid- and cooperation.
Comedy Quest is a point and click adventure game by Trav Nash. Can you become the greatest comedian in three gigs?
REDEEMER: Enhanced Edition은 근접 전투 중심의 잔혹한 브롤러입니다. 주먹, 무기, 환경을 활용해 적을 파괴하세요. 깊이 있는 전투 시스템과 강렬한 피니셔를 마스터하고 바실리로서 구원을 위해 싸우세요.
Erevael은 게임을 할 때마다 달라지는 헥스 맵 위의 판타지 RPG입니다. 클래스는 없습니다. 교역과 지도 제작부터 마법과 전투까지, 무엇이든 하는 일에 따라 실력이 늘어납니다. 캐릭터가 은퇴하면 그 후계자로 이어서 플레이하며, 주문과 레시피, 지도를 물려받습니다.
19세기의 가장 불안한 우주선을 타고 2인용 모험을 떠나 보세요. 39 Days to Mars는 두 명의 플레이어가 모두 중요한 역할을 수행하는 독특한 디자인의 게임입니다. 1인용 플레이는 컴퓨터가 조종하는 고양이의 도움으로 플레이 가능합니다.

Build up your own arms manufacturing company. Find your factory, buy resources, produce a wide range of military equipment to sell to the highest bidder. Good or bad? That's up to you, who you do business with is your choice. Don't ask, don't tell, get paid. After all, war is about making money.

Trials Fusion is the gold-standard platform racer for the next-generation of gaming. Built upon the Trials franchise’s proven gameplay foundations, Fusion challenges players endlessly in both classic and all-new ways.
Play alone or with friends! A co-op personality test about exploring an ancient, occult world in 5 days. How will you be remembered?
Against explosive firepower, bitter cold, and dizzying heights, Fork Parker must outwit a group of no-talent game developers in a deadly holiday promotional game. Also, it's free.

Toonstruck combines live action, cell animation, and an all star cast: Christopher Lloyd, Ben Stein, Dan Castellaneta, Tim Curry, and Dom DeLuise, for a not-to-be-missed adventure through a zany cartoon world on the brink of total Malevalation!

en: Tokyo Twilight Ghost Hunters Daybreak: Special Gigs
ko: Tokyo Twilight Ghost Hunters Daybreak: Special Gigs
desc: A ghostly fusion of Visual Novel and tactical RPG, which sees you hunting ghosts as part of the Gate Keepers, a team of school friends from the Kurenai Academy. Boasting gorgeous artwork and smart strategic battles, this is a must for those who like a side order of gameplay with their Visual Novels.
The Chosen is a heroic RPG inspired by the Dragon Quest Series and Chrono Trigger. Will you be able to unravel the mysterious plot against you and become the Chosen?

en: New York Mysteries: The Lantern of Souls Collector's Edition
ko: New York Mysteries: The Lantern of Souls Collector's Edition
desc: 뉴욕 미스터리: 영혼의 랜턴은 모험적인 숨은 물건 찾기 게임으로 퍼즐과 미니게임을 해결하며 임무를 완수합니다. 이번에는 용감한 기자 로라 제임스의 위험하고도 기이한 조사 이야기가 등장합니다.
Cube Runner is a 3d action platformer that's simple to learn, exciting to play, and deep enough to challenge even the greatest gamers.

Disneyland Adventures allows fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park, enjoy adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved characters. Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.
타락한 마법사는 거대한 판타지 전략 게임이다. 영웅을 모집, 퀘스트에 가서 군대를 훈련, 도시를 구축하고 풍부한 RPG 세계에서 동맹을 위조.

Experience a Narrative Adventure where your choices and character growth truly matter. As a member of a 1793 secret society, live a tale of intrigue and manipulation on the hunt for your missing mother.
Delve into a world where war has become a media frenzy! Survive your battles and bet on your victories!
Enjoy a fast and frantic arcade shmup from Triangle Service! Attack in all directions and rack up the multipliers - do you have XIIZEAL?

en: The Last Door: Season 2 - Collector's Edition
ko: The Last Door: Season 2 - Collector's Edition
desc: In Season 2 of The Last Door, the search for his missing client will bring psychiatrist John Wakefield deeper into a conspiracy of darkness and closer to the heart of madness than ever before.
Varenje는 퍼즐과 미니게임으로 이루어진 아기자기하고 다채로운 어드벤처입니다. 게임을 예술이라 생각하는 분들을 위해 아티스트들이 만들었습니다.

Calm Down, Stalin is a game where you directly control your hands to threaten your enemies with nuclear weapons by moving your finger closer to The Button while signing important state papers, answering phone, dealing with your subordinates and fighting the stress of your job by smoking your pipe!
In the end, everybody gets what they deserve. The sins of the past always manifest within the minds of the sinners. An eternity of suffering awaits, welcome to The Survey.

ko: Naval Armada: 해군 전함 전쟁 멀티 플레이
desc: 전함은 당신에게 도전을 보냅니다! 적을 상대로 친구와 함께 플레이하고 어뢰 보트 구축함,순양함 및 전함에서 서사시 전투에서 승리하십시오! 자신의 게임 전략을 구축하고 상대에게 기회를 남겨!

A light-hearted turn-based RPG, heavily inspired by old 2D classics. You will battle through waves of cute enemies, grow your characters, explore a diverse world, solve puzzles, and of course, save the world. (Just updated to version 3!)
Fight for control of a frontier world. Gather resources, build your base, and command your forces in battle. Survive long enough to unleash your ultimate weapon - THE EPIC.
The Technomancer is a sci-fi RPG that offers players plenty of dynamic combat action based on 4 skill trees dedicated to 3 combat styles and the destructive electrical powers of the Technomancers.

Visibility is a platformer that is completely dark until you place your lights. Each level has a limited set of lights which you must strategically place around the level in order to illuminate your path to the exit.

2D platforming with an emphasis on speed and exploration! Absorb enemy attacks to charge up your own attacks! You must absorb, dodge and weave your way through intense gauntlets and defeat your evil self.
“The Construct” is a classical top-down view adventure indie game. The gameplay mixes retro-like gameplay mechanics with modern features and a spectacular atmosphere and mysterious storyline.
ASSASSINATION BOX is a first person shooter. Fight endless waves of enemies in Survival mode or start stealth night mission. Fight for a better score and higher rank.

The world's favourite gladiator game has returned, bigger and more action packed than ever. Swords and Sandals 2: Emperor's Reign, remastered with all new graphics, music and powerful new skills and awesome Arena Champions Pharoah King, John the Butcher and Ultra Flavlus

Dungeon of the ENDLESS™ is a Rogue-Like Dungeon-Defense game, in which the player and their team of heroes must protect the generator of their crashed ship while exploring an ever-expanding dungeon, all while facing waves of monsters and special events as they try to find their way out...

Split/Second is an intense action racing game set within a reality TV show. Competitors vie to be the first to the finish line in a set rigged to blow. Players don’t just collide with other vehicles to knock them from the track, but can also trigger devastating events that alter the race dynamics.
Based on the classic tabletop game, Warhammer Quest is an addictive mix of role-playing and strategy.

Titanic: The Game takes place aboard the R.M.S. Titanic on her fateful maiden voyage across the Atlantic. The player’s avatar is a young socialite, Margaret Ashley, one of the fortunate unfortunates who sailed on Titanic and survived.

Step into the Warhammer Fantasy world like never before in this short and fun VR experience. As an aspiring hero, you need to prove your worth by outsmarting the cunning Skaven, using your expert marksmanship and keen melee skills. For the Empire!
The Cubicle is a short VR experience about your regular everyday job in an office, or is it?

Dynamite Alex is an action platform-shooter starring a 17-year old tomboy named Alexandra Tobynskii. After a cliched outbreak of robbers invading the city, it's up to her to investigate what's going on! Donning glorious retro flair, the game transports players back to when gameplay was king!

Delilah is an ordinary school girl who accidentally discovers an old mansion on a rainy night. As her exploration in the mansion continues, she finds many mysterious phenomena that can't be explained. In this mansion covered by ashes, what's the secret hidden deep underground?

en: The Adventurer - Episode 1: Beginning of the End
ko: The Adventurer - Episode 1: Beginning of the End
desc: Imagine if every time you fall asleep, a new adventure awaits you.

“METAL SLUG 3”, the masterpiece in SNK’s emblematic 2D run & gun action shooting game series, still continues to fascinate millions of fans worldwide to this day for its intricate dot-pixel graphics, and simple and intuitive game controls, heads out to the Steam gaming platform!

Pandora: First Contact is a science fiction 4X turn-based strategy game on a planetary scale. Our Earth has been exhausted and colonial attempts on other planetary bodies have been in vain. Finally, after decades of exploration, an interstellar probe has brought promise of a new world.
Explore an abandoned space station in this retro-themed explorative action platformer.
오 이런! 이 귀여운 작은 고양이는 유령이 나오는 집에서 혼자 길을 잃었어요! 동전을 모으고 괴물을 물리쳐야만 그녀는 출구를 찾을 수 있습니다! 빠른 손놀림으로 이 사랑스럽고 어둡고 재미있는 플랫폼 게임을 정복하세요.

Stardust Galaxy Warriors: Stellar Climax is a fast-paced couch co-op action shooter with SHMUP/Brawler gameplay and RPG elements. Choose your mechs, weapons & upgrades then soar through space, defeat evil & save the future... from itself!
«Road Madness» is an Arcade Racing Game with some action elements.
Relaxing puzzle game in a minimal style.

en: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill - Slaps And Beans
ko: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill - Slaps And Beans
desc: Bud Spencer and Terence Hill in their first virtual adventure. Slaps And Beans is a co-operative or single player scrolling beat’ em up game with the addition of platform elements and mini-games in which you'll interpret the characters of Bud Spencer and Terence Hill

Shishimai Rinka was a high schooler who ran a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother. She lived her life much like any other person her age, but one day, she was caught up in an explosion while returning home on the train alongside her friend, Hitsuji Naomi.
Have you ever wanted to be president? or prime-minister? Convinced you could do a better job of running the country? Let's face it, you could hardly do a worse job than our current political leaders.

Star Sonata 2 is a space sandbox MMO that combines elements of action, RPG, and empire creation into a truly unique MMO. Explore the sandbox style universe, build persistent bases, construct trade ships, and even fight your way to the top and claim the Emperor’s Throne!

Deep Eclipse: New Space Odyssey is the ultimate space thriller in the best tradition of the genre. You're the pilot of a space fighter, accidentally catapulted into a parallel universe populated by hostile alien creatures; and they're not happy to see you! To get out of this hell, do your best, to destroy hordes of enemies.

Raywin is a 90's style 2d RPG. The story focuses around the main protagonist Raywin who, because of prophecy, has to go off to fight in the war of Salemsun and save the kingdom. Along the way he is accompanied by his friend Helena who he at first hates, but along the way they grow closer than ever.

Dry summer withered the king’s beloved garden and the surrounding gardens of the kingdom alike. The ruler has fallen ill and the kingdom is in danger. Help the princess save the gardens and make the king better again.
Explore what was out of reach before - travel to mesmerizing real world places and discover their stories!

BeachHead 2002 follows on the success of BeachHead 2000 with ease to play, hard to master, non-stop 3D shooting action. Play BeachHead 2002 and relive the nostalgia of the classic arcade gaming on Windows 10 and 11!

en: SWAT 3: Tactical Game of the Year Edition
ko: SWAT 3: Tactical Game of the Year Edition
desc: Uncompromised duty, honor and valor.

Start an exciting adventure with Tri Peaks Solitaire game (also known as TriTowers, Triple Peaks, Three Peaks or Pyramid Solitaire). Mystic Journey: Tri Peaks Solitaire is a captivating card solitaire game that combines in itself strategy, attention span and brain responsivity.
복잡하지만 만족스러운 전투 시스템과 함께 강력한 마법을 사용할 수 있는 다크 판타지 액션-RPG에 뛰어드십시오. 폭군이자 신, 아르디는 오랜 투옥에 대한 복수를 위해 인간 영역을 침략하자, 보호자라고 하기엔 꺼림직한 인간… 추방된 범죄자… 하르킨을 부르게 됩니다.
신비한 수중의 도시에서 사라진 피앙세를 찾으세요!

SpyParty is a competitive espionage game about subtle human behavior. A Spy hides in plain sight at a fancy cocktail party, trying to accomplish missions while blending in with the other guests, while a Sniper with a single bullet looks inward, searching for the Spy.

en: Why Am I Dead At Sea
ko: Why Am I Dead At Sea
desc: Why Am I Dead At Sea is an adventure game where you solve the mystery of your own murder. As a ghost, you will have to possess people and use them to investigate your surroundings. But in this place no one is who they seem...and everyone has a secret.

Life is Hard is a godsim town simulator game developed by a two-man-team. Your main aim here is to manage your town. Expand your domain, prevent famine, make war, trade with others, attract new people. Make history!
A young man, who suffered a phenomenon that he had never seen, faces an ominous power that threatens the fabric of reality. Awaken the power of Memory to restore what was lost!

Well, we crash-landed that UFO in the desert and Bubba says he wants to go home. Heck, I don't blame him 'cause there ain't no place like Hickston. But according to my map, we're gonna have to blast our way through jack o' lope farms and a riverboat as well as a brothel 'fore we get home again.

Io is a man who has no luck with the ladies, and now he's tasked with recruiting Monster Girls to save the world in this moe-filled dungeon RPG! Recruit 50 Monster Girls! Combine their Moe Traits! Build relationships with them and find out just how cute a monster can be!

en: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 3 Full Burst HD
ko: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 3 Full Burst HD
desc: Live the 4th Great Ninja War and its overpowering boss fights or defy your friends in ultra dynamic online and offline ninja confrontations!

Betrayal, power, and revenge... Settle your father’s unfinished business on the cold streets of Ankara. Shift the balance of power in the underworld, unmask the Dark Council, and seize control of the streets.
'블레이블루: 컨티뉴엄 시프트 익스텐드'는 아케이드 버전인 '블레이블루: 컨티뉴엄 시프트 Ⅱ'를 이식한 대전 격투 게임으로써, 다양한 추가 요소가 더해졌다. 대대적인 게임 밸런스 조정이 이뤄졌고 신규 캐릭터로 '레리우스 클로버'가 추가, 스토리 모드에 신규 캐릭터의 시나리오가 추가되었다.

Girlfriend Rescue is a thrilling adventure where the gameplay of "Dragon Quest" meets the atmosphere of "Streets of Rage". Innovative, mixing rogue-style RPG and Beat'em Up atmosphere in a unique way, this game features a great deal of strategy through a mix of character selection & creative skills.
''No70: Eye of Basir'' is a story based first person perspective adventure game which focused on investigation. Players will help Aras and Erhan to solve the mystery about Basir and the No70 house.

Welcome to ChromaTec’s test lab! You’re here to test our state-of-the-art military-grade color-technology: The ChromaGun (patent pending)! Use it to solve our meticulously designed test chambers by painting the walls and droids. Remember how to mix colors from pre-school? Then you qualify!

STRAFE® is the worlds bloodiest roguelike first-person shooter! Featuring mind melting secrets and persistent gore that allows you to paint levels red with the excessive entrails of your enemies. 30+ weapons, 20+ enemies, & a red hot soundtrack.
All Curtis wants is to live a normal, happy life, but something seems to have other plans...
That's Mahjong! is a Solitaire Mahjong tile matching game, where the purpose is to match tiles of the same type, or any two season tiles. How much karma can you gather?

en: Ys VI: The Ark of Napishtim
ko: Ys VI: The Ark of Napishtim
desc: Adventurer Adol Christin has washed ashore in yet another mysterious, isolated new land, inhabited by a people who sport long ears and bushy tails...and are none too fond of humans. Experience the very first 3D Ys game as never before, with a whole new gameplay mode unique to this release!
Time, Space and Parallel Universes collapse and merge, tethered to threads of reality and sustained by a paradoxical power source. Nothing is impossible - it is time to become a Data Hacker.

Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of early 2000s Russia as you investigate the theft of a city relic. Interact with unique characters, make difficult decisions, and find your path. Save your hometown or feed it to the fiends.

Galagan's Island is an Arcade style Space Shooter paying loving homage to classic arcade style & difficulty. This Bullet Hell is sure to satisfy your Shmup Shortage! Featuring 25 LEVELS of handcrafted whimsical charm. Formations so pretty you almost don't want to destroy them.

en: The Aquatic Adventure of the Last Human
ko: The Aquatic Adventure of the Last Human
desc: Explore the ruins of the human race and discover the thriving wildlife that blossomed after our extinction in this underwater action/adventure. Encounter monstrous creatures and let curiosity guide you through an inevitable voyage of extinction.
For 3-8 players and an audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The game of terrible drawings and hilariously wrong answers.

Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fighting underworld creatures along the way, all while avoiding traps and collecting loot!
누구보다도 빠르게, 누구보다도 강하게, 그리고 아름답게. 배틀 레이싱과 로봇 커스터마이즈의 조합, 레이싱. 배틀. 커스터마이징. 그 모든것에 독특한 재미를 선사한다. 온라인, 오프라인, 타임어택, 당신은 어떤 모드로 플레이할 것인가?

Hungry? Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in Cook, Serve, Delicious! Plan your menu, upgrade your equipment, and master challenges with easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay!

Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!
Angvik is a platform action game set in a joyful but unforgiving land.
You are Kayto Shields, an ordinary man thrown into an extraordinary adventure. Control Kayto's day to day life as well as his responsibilities as club manager in this stat management sim.
A teenage girl and the vengeful ghost possessing her stumble onto horrors of cosmic proportions as the latter searches for a way to murder the former.
Solve the mystery at the heart of this chilling thriller!
Enter a dark wasteland and fight mutants to survive.
A first-person puzzle game. Simply walk to the door.
Choose your Realm and engage in the most dynamic player driven battlefield available on any MMO. Fight for the Alsius Empire, protect the woods of Syrtis or avenge the Brotherhood of Ignis.
In a post-apocalyptic wasteland of diesel and dust, bandits and mobsters rule the last remaining cities, controlling all vital trade routes and destroying any hope of a return to a lawful world.
Shoot rubber ducky arrows, pound enemies with a rhino hammer, and help Beethoven get his groove back in the last totally normal high school themed RPGvania you’ll ever want.
마지막 거인을 처치하세요!
Asteroid Bounty Hunter is a space shooter mixed with interesting boss fights and breathtaking visuals, with a reward system to take your skill to another level.

The official adaptation of the legendary wargame from Steve Jackson Games. Engage in futuristic warfare with armored hovercraft, superheavy tanks, infantry, and giant cybernetic war machines called "Ogres".

Your daughter was gone at a research of the abandoned bunker. Having gone to find her, you meet the horrors living in these walls, solve puzzles, discover what has happened in this place and to find the daughter. Everything that you have, is a lamp which charge constantly decreases also the radio.

Every world needs its heroes. However unlikely they may seem. Join Wilbur, Ivo, Nate and Critter in another classic point-and-click adventure in the wicked world of Aventásia. Help them fulfill their destiny. A destiny as yet unwritten.
